                Parent = ScreenGui;
            });

            local TransparencyCache = {};
            local FadeTargets = {}; -- cached list of {Instance, Property, OriginalValue}
            local Toggled = false;
            local Fading = false;
            local TargetsBuilt = false;

            local function BuildFadeTargets()
                if TargetsBuilt then return end;
                TargetsBuilt = true;
                for _, Desc in next, Outer:GetDescendants() do
                    local Properties = {};
                    if Desc:IsA('ImageLabel') then
                        Properties = {'ImageTransparency', 'BackgroundTransparency'};
                    elseif Desc:IsA('TextLabel') or Desc:IsA('TextBox') then
                        Properties = {'TextTransparency'};
                    elseif Desc:IsA('Frame') or Desc:IsA('ScrollingFrame') then
                        Properties = {'BackgroundTransparency'};
                    elseif Desc:IsA('UIStroke') then
                        Properties = {'Transparency'};
                    end;
                    for _, Prop in next, Properties do
                        local Cache = TransparencyCache[Desc];
                        if not Cache then
                            Cache = {};
                            TransparencyCache[Desc] = Cache;
                        end;
                        if not Cache[Prop] then
                            Cache[Prop] = Desc[Prop];
                        end;
                        if Cache[Prop] ~= 1 then
                            table.insert(FadeTargets, {Desc, Prop, Cache[Prop]});
                        end;
                    end;
                end;
            end;

            function Library:Toggle()
                if Fading then
                    return;
                end;

                local FadeTime = Config.MenuFadeTime;
                Fading = true;
                Toggled = (not Toggled);
                ModalElement.Modal = Toggled;

                if Toggled then
                    Outer.Visible = true;
                end;

                BuildFadeTargets();

                local FadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(FadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
                for _, Target in next, FadeTargets do
                    TweenService:Create(Target[1], FadeInfo, {
                        [Target[2]] = Toggled and Target[3] or 1
                    }):Play();
                end;

                task.wait(FadeTime);
                Outer.Visible = Toggled;
                Fading = false;
            end

            Library:GiveSignal(InputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, Processed)
                if Processed then return end
                if type(Library.ToggleKeybind) == 'table' and Library.ToggleKeybind.Type == 'KeyPicker' then
                    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and Input.KeyCode.Name == Library.ToggleKeybind.Value then
                        task.spawn(Library.Toggle)
                    end
                elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or (Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift and (not Processed)) then
                    task.spawn(Library.Toggle)
                end
            end))

            if Config.AutoShow then task.spawn(Library.Toggle) end

            Window.Holder = Outer;

            return Window;
        end;

        local function OnPlayerChange()
            local PlayerList = GetPlayersString();

            for _, Value in next, Options do
                if Value.Type == 'Dropdown' and Value.SpecialType == 'Player' then
                    Value:SetValues(PlayerList);
                end;
            end;
        end;

        local _playerDebounce = false
        local function OnPlayerChangeDebounced()
            if _playerDebounce then return end
            _playerDebounce = true
            task.delay(0.5, function()
                _playerDebounce = false
                OnPlayerChange()
            end)
        end

        -- These listeners outlive individual widgets, so they must be library-owned and
        -- disconnected by Unload. Without tracking them, each compatible re-execution
        -- retains an old library closure and repeats player-special dropdown refreshes.
        Library:GiveSignal(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerChangeDebounced));
        Library:GiveSignal(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(OnPlayerChangeDebounced));

        _genv.Library = Library
        return Library
    end)() end)
    if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' then
        __SamiHubFail('Library', 'library/latest_library_runtime_optimized_AUTOFIT.txt', ok and ('returned ' .. type(result)) or result)
        return
    end
    Library = result
end
Runtime.Library = Library
-- ThemeManager
-- Inlined from library/ThemeManager.lua
--   (was: loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/violin-suzutsuki/LinoriaLib/main/addons/ThemeManager.lua'))())
--   sha256 069EEFC43AAB583E0270794B7357B909E7B085FCCA37DFA5CD246908B628EE11  (verbatim)
--
-- Function scope: locals are released on return and never touch the main
-- chunk's 200-register budget. pcall: a load failure prints + shows an
-- on-screen error and returns, instead of aborting the script silently.
local ThemeManager
do
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return (function()
        local httpService = game:GetService('HttpService')
        local ThemeManager = {} do
                ThemeManager.Folder = 'LinoriaLibSettings'
                -- if not isfolder(ThemeManager.Folder) then makefolder(ThemeManager.Folder) end

                ThemeManager.Library = nil
                ThemeManager.BuiltInThemes = {
                        ['Default']             = { 1, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"1c1c1c","AccentColor":"0055ff","BackgroundColor":"141414","OutlineColor":"323232"}') },
                        ['BBot']                        = { 2, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"1e1e1e","AccentColor":"7e48a3","BackgroundColor":"232323","OutlineColor":"141414"}') },
                        ['Fatality']            = { 3, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"1e1842","AccentColor":"c50754","BackgroundColor":"191335","OutlineColor":"3c355d"}') },
                        ['Jester']                      = { 4, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"242424","AccentColor":"db4467","BackgroundColor":"1c1c1c","OutlineColor":"373737"}') },
                        ['Mint']                        = { 5, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"242424","AccentColor":"3db488","BackgroundColor":"1c1c1c","OutlineColor":"373737"}') },
                        ['Tokyo Night']         = { 6, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"191925","AccentColor":"6759b3","BackgroundColor":"16161f","OutlineColor":"323232"}') },
                        ['Ubuntu']                      = { 7, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"3e3e3e","AccentColor":"e2581e","BackgroundColor":"323232","OutlineColor":"191919"}') },
                        ['Quartz']                      = { 8, httpService:JSONDecode('{"FontColor":"ffffff","MainColor":"232330","AccentColor":"426e87","BackgroundColor":"1d1b26","OutlineColor":"27232f"}') },
                }

                function ThemeManager:ApplyTheme(theme)
                        local customThemeData = self:GetCustomTheme(theme)
                        local data = customThemeData or self.BuiltInThemes[theme]

                        if not data then return end

                        -- custom themes are just regular dictionaries instead of an array with { index, dictionary }

                        local scheme = data[2]
                        for idx, col in next, customThemeData or scheme do
                                self.Library[idx] = Color3.fromHex(col)
                                
                                if Options[idx] then
                                        Options[idx]:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromHex(col))
                                end
                        end

                        self:ThemeUpdate()
                end

                function ThemeManager:ThemeUpdate()
                        -- This allows us to force apply themes without loading the themes tab :)
                        local options = { "FontColor", "MainColor", "AccentColor", "BackgroundColor", "OutlineColor" }
                        for i, field in next, options do
                                if Options and Options[field] then
                                        self.Library[field] = Options[field].Value
                                end
                        end

                        self.Library.AccentColorDark = self.Library:GetDarkerColor(self.Library.AccentColor);
                        self.Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()
                end

                function ThemeManager:LoadDefault()             
                        local theme = 'Default'
                        local content = isfile(self.Folder .. '/themes/default.txt') and readfile(self.Folder .. '/themes/default.txt')

                        local isDefault = true
                        if content then
                                if self.BuiltInThemes[content] then
                                        theme = content
                                elseif self:GetCustomTheme(content) then
                                        theme = content
                                        isDefault = false;
                                end
                        elseif self.BuiltInThemes[self.DefaultTheme] then
                                theme = self.DefaultTheme
                        end

                        if isDefault then
                                Options.ThemeManager_ThemeList:SetValue(theme)
                        else
                                self:ApplyTheme(theme)
                        end
                end

                function ThemeManager:SaveDefault(theme)
                        writefile(self.Folder .. '/themes/default.txt', theme)
                end

                function ThemeManager:CreateThemeManager(groupbox)
                        groupbox:AddLabel('Background color'):AddColorPicker('BackgroundColor', { Default = self.Library.BackgroundColor });
                        groupbox:AddLabel('Main color') :AddColorPicker('MainColor', { Default = self.Library.MainColor });
                        groupbox:AddLabel('Accent color'):AddColorPicker('AccentColor', { Default = self.Library.AccentColor });
                        groupbox:AddLabel('Outline color'):AddColorPicker('OutlineColor', { Default = self.Library.OutlineColor });
                        groupbox:AddLabel('Font color') :AddColorPicker('FontColor', { Default = self.Library.FontColor });

                        local ThemesArray = {}
                        for Name, Theme in next, self.BuiltInThemes do
                                table.insert(ThemesArray, Name)
                        end

                        table.sort(ThemesArray, function(a, b) return self.BuiltInThemes[a][1] < self.BuiltInThemes[b][1] end)

                        groupbox:AddDivider()
                        groupbox:AddDropdown('ThemeManager_ThemeList', { Text = 'Theme list', Values = ThemesArray, Default = 1 })

                        groupbox:AddButton('Set as default', function()
                                self:SaveDefault(Options.ThemeManager_ThemeList.Value)
                                self.Library:Notify(string.format('Set default theme to %q', Options.ThemeManager_ThemeList.Value))
                        end)

                        Options.ThemeManager_ThemeList:OnChanged(function()
                                self:ApplyTheme(Options.ThemeManager_ThemeList.Value)
                        end)

                        groupbox:AddDivider()
                        groupbox:AddInput('ThemeManager_CustomThemeName', { Text = 'Custom theme name' })
                        groupbox:AddDropdown('ThemeManager_CustomThemeList', { Text = 'Custom themes', Values = self:ReloadCustomThemes(), AllowNull = true, Default = 1 })
                        groupbox:AddDivider()
                        
                        groupbox:AddButton('Save theme', function() 
                                self:SaveCustomTheme(Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeName.Value)

                                Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList:SetValues(self:ReloadCustomThemes())
                                Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList:SetValue(nil)
                        end):AddButton('Load theme', function() 
                                self:ApplyTheme(Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList.Value) 
                        end)

                        groupbox:AddButton('Refresh list', function()
                                Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList:SetValues(self:ReloadCustomThemes())
                                Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList:SetValue(nil)
                        end)

                        groupbox:AddButton('Set as default', function()
                                if Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList.Value ~= nil and Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList.Value ~= '' then
                                        self:SaveDefault(Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList.Value)
                                        self.Library:Notify(string.format('Set default theme to %q', Options.ThemeManager_CustomThemeList.Value))
                                end
                        end)

                        ThemeManager:LoadDefault()

                        local function UpdateTheme()
                                self:ThemeUpdate()
                        end

                        Options.BackgroundColor:OnChanged(UpdateTheme)
                        Options.MainColor:OnChanged(UpdateTheme)
                        Options.AccentColor:OnChanged(UpdateTheme)
                        Options.OutlineColor:OnChanged(UpdateTheme)
                        Options.FontColor:OnChanged(UpdateTheme)
                end

                function ThemeManager:GetCustomTheme(file)
                        local path = self.Folder .. '/themes/' .. file
                        if not isfile(path) then
                                return nil
                        end

                        local data = readfile(path)
                        local success, decoded = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, data)
                        
                        if not success then
                                return nil
                        end

                        return decoded
                end

                function ThemeManager:SaveCustomTheme(file)
                        if file:gsub(' ', '') == '' then
                                return self.Library:Notify('Invalid file name for theme (empty)', 3)
                        end

                        local theme = {}
                        local fields = { "FontColor", "MainColor", "AccentColor", "BackgroundColor", "OutlineColor" }

                        for _, field in next, fields do
                                theme[field] = Options[field].Value:ToHex()
                        end

                        writefile(self.Folder .. '/themes/' .. file .. '.json', httpService:JSONEncode(theme))
                end

                function ThemeManager:ReloadCustomThemes()
                        local list = listfiles(self.Folder .. '/themes')

                        local out = {}
                        for i = 1, #list do
                                local file = list[i]
                                if file:sub(-5) == '.json' then
                                        -- i hate this but it has to be done ...

                                        local pos = file:find('.json', 1, true)
                                        local char = file:sub(pos, pos)

                                        while char ~= '/' and char ~= '\\' and char ~= '' do
                                                pos = pos - 1
                                                char = file:sub(pos, pos)
                                        end

                                        if char == '/' or char == '\\' then
                                                table.insert(out, file:sub(pos + 1))
                                        end
                                end
                        end

                        return out
                end

                function ThemeManager:SetLibrary(lib)
                        self.Library = lib
                end

                function ThemeManager:BuildFolderTree()
                        local paths = {}

                        -- build the entire tree if a path is like some-hub/phantom-forces
                        -- makefolder builds the entire tree on Synapse X but not other exploits

                        local parts = self.Folder:split('/')
                        for idx = 1, #parts do
                                paths[#paths + 1] = table.concat(parts, '/', 1, idx)
                        end

                        table.insert(paths, self.Folder .. '/themes')
                        table.insert(paths, self.Folder .. '/settings')

                        for i = 1, #paths do
                                local str = paths[i]
                                if not isfolder(str) then
                                        makefolder(str)
                                end
                        end
                end

                function ThemeManager:SetFolder(folder)
                        self.Folder = folder
                        self:BuildFolderTree()
                end

                function ThemeManager:CreateGroupBox(tab)
                        assert(self.Library, 'Must set ThemeManager.Library first!')
                        return tab:AddLeftGroupbox('Themes')
                end

                function ThemeManager:ApplyToTab(tab)
                        assert(self.Library, 'Must set ThemeManager.Library first!')
                        local groupbox = self:CreateGroupBox(tab)
                        self:CreateThemeManager(groupbox)
                end

                function ThemeManager:ApplyToGroupbox(groupbox)
                        assert(self.Library, 'Must set ThemeManager.Library first!')
                        self:CreateThemeManager(groupbox)
                end

                ThemeManager:BuildFolderTree()
        end

        return ThemeManager
    end)() end)
    if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' then
        __SamiHubFail('ThemeManager', 'library/ThemeManager.lua', ok and ('returned ' .. type(result)) or result)
        return
    end
    ThemeManager = result
end

    },

-- SaveManager
-- Inlined from library/SaveManager.lua
--   (was: loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/violin-suzutsuki/LinoriaLib/main/addons/SaveManager.lua'))())
--   sha256 2E5E5AF11CF5803F05B69842AA20BC41133044E3CABDF67B40C0D3700170F7B7  (verbatim)
--
-- Function scope: locals are released on return and never touch the main
-- chunk's 200-register budget. pcall: a load failure prints + shows an
-- on-screen error and returns, instead of aborting the script silently.
local SaveManager
do
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return (function()
        local httpService = game:GetService('HttpService')

        local SaveManager = {} do
                SaveManager.Folder = 'LinoriaLibSettings'
                SaveManager.Ignore = {}
                SaveManager.Parser = {
                        Toggle = {
                                Save = function(idx, object) 
                                        return { type = 'Toggle', idx = idx, value = object.Value } 
                                end,
                                Load = function(idx, data)
                                        if Toggles[idx] then 
                                                Toggles[idx]:SetValue(data.value)
                                        end
                                end,
                        },
                        Slider = {
                                Save = function(idx, object)
                                        return { type = 'Slider', idx = idx, value = tostring(object.Value) }
                                end,
                                Load = function(idx, data)
                                        if Options[idx] then 
                                                Options[idx]:SetValue(data.value)
                                        end
                                end,
                        },
                        Dropdown = {
                                Save = function(idx, object)
                                        return { type = 'Dropdown', idx = idx, value = object.Value, mutli = object.Multi }
                                end,
                                Load = function(idx, data)
                                        if Options[idx] then 
                                                Options[idx]:SetValue(data.value)
                                        end
                                end,
                        },
                        ColorPicker = {
                                Save = function(idx, object)
                                        return { type = 'ColorPicker', idx = idx, value = object.Value:ToHex(), transparency = object.Transparency }
                                end,
                                Load = function(idx, data)
                                        if Options[idx] then 
                                                Options[idx]:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromHex(data.value), data.transparency)
                                        end
                                end,
                        },
                        KeyPicker = {
                                Save = function(idx, object)
                                        return { type = 'KeyPicker', idx = idx, mode = object.Mode, key = object.Value }
                                end,
                                Load = function(idx, data)
                                        if Options[idx] then 
                                                Options[idx]:SetValue({ data.key, data.mode })
                                        end
                                end,
                        },

                        Input = {
                                Save = function(idx, object)
                                        return { type = 'Input', idx = idx, text = object.Value }
                                end,
                                Load = function(idx, data)
                                        if Options[idx] and type(data.text) == 'string' then
                                                Options[idx]:SetValue(data.text)
                                        end
                                end,
                        },
                }

                function SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes(list)
                        for _, key in next, list do
                                self.Ignore[key] = true
                        end
                end

                function SaveManager:SetFolder(folder)
                        self.Folder = folder;
                        self:BuildFolderTree()
                end

                function SaveManager:Save(name)
                        if (not name) then
                                return false, 'no config file is selected'
                        end

                        local fullPath = self.Folder .. '/settings/' .. name .. '.json'

                        local data = {
                                objects = {}
                        }

                        for idx, toggle in next, Toggles do
                                if self.Ignore[idx] then continue end

                                table.insert(data.objects, self.Parser[toggle.Type].Save(idx, toggle))
                        end

                        for idx, option in next, Options do
                                if not self.Parser[option.Type] then continue end
                                if self.Ignore[idx] then continue end

                                table.insert(data.objects, self.Parser[option.Type].Save(idx, option))
                        end     

                        local success, encoded = pcall(httpService.JSONEncode, httpService, data)
                        if not success then
                                return false, 'failed to encode data'
                        end

                        writefile(fullPath, encoded)
                        return true
                end

                function SaveManager:Load(name)
                        if (not name) then
                                return false, 'no config file is selected'
                        end
                        
                        local file = self.Folder .. '/settings/' .. name .. '.json'
                        if not isfile(file) then return false, 'invalid file' end

                        local success, decoded = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, readfile(file))
                        if not success then return false, 'decode error' end

                        for _, option in next, decoded.objects do
                                if self.Parser[option.type] then
                                        task.spawn(function() self.Parser[option.type].Load(option.idx, option) end) -- task.spawn() so the config loading wont get stuck.
                                end
                        end

                        return true
                end

                function SaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
                        self:SetIgnoreIndexes({ 
                                "BackgroundColor", "MainColor", "AccentColor", "OutlineColor", "FontColor", -- themes
                                "ThemeManager_ThemeList", 'ThemeManager_CustomThemeList', 'ThemeManager_CustomThemeName', -- themes
                        })
                end

                function SaveManager:BuildFolderTree()
                        local paths = {
                                self.Folder,
                                self.Folder .. '/themes',
                                self.Folder .. '/settings'
                        }

                        for i = 1, #paths do
                                local str = paths[i]
                                if not isfolder(str) then
                                        makefolder(str)
                                end
                        end
                end

                function SaveManager:RefreshConfigList()
                        local list = listfiles(self.Folder .. '/settings')

                        local out = {}
                        for i = 1, #list do
                                local file = list[i]
                                if file:sub(-5) == '.json' then
                                        -- i hate this but it has to be done ...

                                        local pos = file:find('.json', 1, true)
                                        local start = pos

                                        local char = file:sub(pos, pos)
                                        while char ~= '/' and char ~= '\\' and char ~= '' do
                                                pos = pos - 1
                                                char = file:sub(pos, pos)
                                        end

                                        if char == '/' or char == '\\' then
                                                table.insert(out, file:sub(pos + 1, start - 1))
                                        end
                                end
                        end
                        
                        return out
                end

                function SaveManager:SetLibrary(library)
                        self.Library = library
                end

                function SaveManager:LoadAutoloadConfig()
                        if isfile(self.Folder .. '/settings/autoload.txt') then
                                local name = readfile(self.Folder .. '/settings/autoload.txt')

                                local success, err = self:Load(name)
                                if not success then
                                        return self.Library:Notify('Failed to load autoload config: ' .. err)
                                end

                                self.Library:Notify(string.format('Auto loaded config %q', name))
                        end
                end


                function SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(tab)
                        assert(self.Library, 'Must set SaveManager.Library')

                        local section = tab:AddRightGroupbox('Configuration')

                        section:AddInput('SaveManager_ConfigName',    { Text = 'Config name' })
                        section:AddDropdown('SaveManager_ConfigList', { Text = 'Config list', Values = self:RefreshConfigList(), AllowNull = true })

                        section:AddDivider()

                        section:AddButton('Create config', function()
                                local name = Options.SaveManager_ConfigName.Value

                                if name:gsub(' ', '') == '' then 
                                        return self.Library:Notify('Invalid config name (empty)', 2)
                                end

                                local success, err = self:Save(name)
                                if not success then
                                        return self.Library:Notify('Failed to save config: ' .. err)
                                end

                                self.Library:Notify(string.format('Created config %q', name))

                                Options.SaveManager_ConfigList:SetValues(self:RefreshConfigList())
                                Options.SaveManager_ConfigList:SetValue(nil)
                        end):AddButton('Load config', function()
                                local name = Options.SaveManager_ConfigList.Value

                                local success, err = self:Load(name)
                                if not success then
                                        return self.Library:Notify('Failed to load config: ' .. err)
                                end

                                self.Library:Notify(string.format('Loaded config %q', name))
                        end)

                        section:AddButton('Overwrite config', function()
                                local name = Options.SaveManager_ConfigList.Value

                                local success, err = self:Save(name)
                                if not success then
                                        return self.Library:Notify('Failed to overwrite config: ' .. err)
                                end

                                self.Library:Notify(string.format('Overwrote config %q', name))
                        end)

                        section:AddButton('Refresh list', function()
                                Options.SaveManager_ConfigList:SetValues(self:RefreshConfigList())
                                Options.SaveManager_ConfigList:SetValue(nil)
                        end)

                        section:AddButton('Set as autoload', function()
                                local name = Options.SaveManager_ConfigList.Value
                                writefile(self.Folder .. '/settings/autoload.txt', name)
                                SaveManager.AutoloadLabel:SetText('Current autoload config: ' .. name)
                                self.Library:Notify(string.format('Set %q to auto load', name))
                        end)

                        SaveManager.AutoloadLabel = section:AddLabel('Current autoload config: none', true)

                        if isfile(self.Folder .. '/settings/autoload.txt') then
                                local name = readfile(self.Folder .. '/settings/autoload.txt')
                                SaveManager.AutoloadLabel:SetText('Current autoload config: ' .. name)
                        end

                        SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({ 'SaveManager_ConfigList', 'SaveManager_ConfigName' })
                end

                SaveManager:BuildFolderTree()
        end

        return SaveManager
    end)() end)
    if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' then
        __SamiHubFail('SaveManager', 'library/SaveManager.lua', ok and ('returned ' .. type(result)) or result)
        return
    end
    SaveManager = result
end

local WorldFolders = {}
local function getWorldFolder(name)
    local folder = WorldFolders[name]
    if not folder or folder.Parent ~= WS then
        folder = WS:FindFirstChild(name)
        WorldFolders[name] = folder
    end
    return folder
end
local ChildRegistries = {}
local function getChildRegistry(name)
    local folder = getWorldFolder(name)
    if not folder then return nil end
    local reg = ChildRegistries[name]
    if reg and reg.folder == folder then return reg.list end
    if reg then
        for _, conn in ipairs(reg.conns) do
            Runtime:UntrackConnection(conn)
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    reg = { folder = folder, list = {}, conns = {} }
    ChildRegistries[name] = reg
    local list = reg.list
    for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do list[#list + 1] = child end
    reg.conns[#reg.conns + 1] = Runtime:TrackConnection(folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        list[#list + 1] = child
    end))
    reg.conns[#reg.conns + 1] = Runtime:TrackConnection(folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
        for i = #list, 1, -1 do
            if list[i] == child then table.remove(list, i) break end
        end
    end))
    return list
end
local SelectedPlayer = nil
Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayerName = nil
Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayer = nil
Runtime.S.CurrentTargetPlayer = nil
Runtime.S.ActiveTween = nil
Runtime.S.SpectateEnabled = false
local function getSelectedPlayer()
    if Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayerName ~= SelectedPlayer
        or (Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayer and Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayer.Parent ~= Players) then
        Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayerName = SelectedPlayer
        Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayer = SelectedPlayer and Players:FindFirstChild(SelectedPlayer) or nil
    end
    return Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayer
end
Runtime.PlayerLeave = {}
Runtime:TrackConnection(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leavingPlayer)
    for _, callback in ipairs(Runtime.PlayerLeave) do
        pcall(callback, leavingPlayer)
    end
end))
table.insert(Runtime.PlayerLeave, function(leavingPlayer)
    if Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayer == leavingPlayer then
        Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayer = nil
        Runtime.S.CachedSelectedPlayerName = nil
    end
    if Runtime.S.CurrentTargetPlayer == leavingPlayer then
        Runtime.S.CurrentTargetPlayer = nil
    end
end)
Runtime.S.SpectateConn = nil
Runtime.S.OriginalCamera = nil
local StartSpectating
local function StopSpectating()
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if Runtime.S.SpectateConn then
        Runtime:UntrackConnection(Runtime.S.SpectateConn)
        Runtime.S.SpectateConn:Disconnect()
        Runtime.S.SpectateConn = nil
    end
    if Runtime.S.OriginalCamera then
        pcall(function() Camera.CameraSubject = Runtime.S.OriginalCamera end)
    else
        pcall(function()
            if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                Camera.CameraSubject = player.Character.Humanoid
            end
        end)
    end
    Runtime.S.OriginalCamera = nil
end
StartSpectating = function()
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Runtime.S.OriginalCamera then Runtime.S.OriginalCamera = Camera.CameraSubject end
    if Runtime.S.SpectateConn then
        Runtime:UntrackConnection(Runtime.S.SpectateConn)
        Runtime.S.SpectateConn:Disconnect()
    end
    Runtime.S.SpectateConn = Runtime:TrackConnection(RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Runtime.S.SpectateEnabled or not SelectedPlayer then StopSpectating(); return end
        pcall(function()
            local target = getSelectedPlayer()
            if target and target.Character then
                local targetHumanoid = target.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if targetHumanoid then Camera.CameraSubject = targetHumanoid
                else StopSpectating() end
            else StopSpectating() end
        end)
    end))
end

local pauseTwn
local function getPredictedPos(targetHRP, history, noPredict)
    if not targetHRP then return nil end
    local cp = targetHRP.Position
    local sampleCount = history and (history.count or #history.positions) or 0
    if noPredict or not history or sampleCount < 2 then
        return cp
    end
    local head = history.head or 1
    local capacity = history.capacity or sampleCount
    local function sampleIndex(logicalIndex)
        if history.head then
            return ((head + logicalIndex - 2) % capacity) + 1
        end
        return logicalIndex
    end
    local tD, tT = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 0
    local previousIndex = sampleIndex(1)
    for logicalIndex = 2, sampleCount do
        local currentIndex = sampleIndex(logicalIndex)
        local d = history.positions[currentIndex] - history.positions[previousIndex]
        local dt = history.timestamps[currentIndex] - history.timestamps[previousIndex]
        if dt > 0 then tD, tT = tD + d, tT + dt end
        previousIndex = currentIndex
    end
    if tT > 0 then
        return cp + ((tD / tT) * Config.PredictionTime)
    end
    return cp
end

    pcall(function() game:GetService("Lighting").BaseAtmosphere:Destroy() end)

    pcall(function()
        local sliceStarted = os.clock()
        for _, v in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") then
                v.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0)
            elseif v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture") then
                v.Transparency = 1
            elseif v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("SpotLight") or v:IsA("Smoke") then
                v.Enabled = false
            elseif v:IsA("Explosion") then
                v.BlastPressure = 1
                v.BlastRadius = 1
            elseif v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("UnionOperation") or v:IsA("CornerWedgePart") or v:IsA("TrussPart") then
                v.Reflectance = 0
            end
            if os.clock() - sliceStarted >= 0.0042 then
                task.wait()
                sliceStarted = os.clock()
            end
        end
    end)
end)

local function purgeLava(container)
    for _, v in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
        if v.Name == "Lava" then
            pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end
local function RemoveAllLava()
    purgeLava(WS)
    purgeLava(RepStorage)
end
do
    local function destroyLava(v)
        if v.Name == "Lava" then pcall(function() v:Destroy() end) end
    end
    Runtime:TrackConnection(WS.DescendantAdded:Connect(destroyLava))
    Runtime:TrackConnection(RepStorage.DescendantAdded:Connect(destroyLava))
end
local function IsAlly(p)
    if not p then return false end
    if p == player then return true end
    if player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Marines" and p.Team and p.Team.Name == "Marines" then return true end
    local pGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pGui and pGui:FindFirstChild("Main") and pGui.Main:FindFirstChild("Allies") and pGui.Main.Allies:FindFirstChild("Container") and pGui.Main.Allies.Container:FindFirstChild("Allies") and pGui.Main.Allies.Container.Allies:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame") and pGui.Main.Allies.Container.Allies.ScrollingFrame:FindFirstChild("Frame") then
        if pGui.Main.Allies.Container.Allies.ScrollingFrame.Frame:FindFirstChild(p.Name) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function sortedKeys(t)
    local keys = {}
    for k in next, t do keys[#keys+1] = tostring(k) end
    table.sort(keys)
    return keys
end
local CachedAllies = {}
local _lastAllyHash = ""
local _allyRefreshNeeded = false
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(1) do
        local temp = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if IsAlly(p) then temp[p] = true end end
        local hash = table.concat(sortedKeys(temp))
        if hash ~= _lastAllyHash then
            _lastAllyHash = hash
            _allyRefreshNeeded = true
        end
        CachedAllies = temp
        task.wait(2)
    end
end)
local SafeZoneCache = {}
local WorldOrigin = nil
local function findWorldOrigin()
    if not WorldOrigin or not WorldOrigin.Parent then
        WorldOrigin = WS:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
    end
    return WorldOrigin
end
local function updateSZCache()
    for i = 1, #SafeZoneCache do SafeZoneCache[i] = nil end
    local wo = findWorldOrigin()
    if not wo then return end
    local szFolder = wo:FindFirstChild("SafeZones")
    if not szFolder then return end
    for _, zone in ipairs(szFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local mesh = zone:FindFirstChild("Mesh")
        if mesh and mesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            SafeZoneCache[#SafeZoneCache + 1] = {zone = zone, radius = (zone.Size.X * mesh.Scale.X) / 2}
        end
    end
end
do
    local function tryInitSZ()
        local wo = findWorldOrigin()
        if not wo then return false end
        local szFolder = wo:FindFirstChild("SafeZones")
        if not szFolder then return false end
        updateSZCache()
        szFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(updateSZCache)
        szFolder.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateSZCache)
        return true
    end
    if not tryInitSZ() then
        task.spawn(function()
            while not tryInitSZ() do
                task.wait(2)
            end
        end)
    end
end
local function inSafeZone(p)
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return false end
    local inCombat = char:GetAttribute("InCombat")
    if inCombat == "1" or inCombat == 1 or inCombat == true then return false end
    local pos = hrp.Position
    for i = 1, #SafeZoneCache do
        local sz = SafeZoneCache[i]
        if (sz.zone.Position - pos).Magnitude <= sz.radius then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function getPVP(p, char)
    if not char or inSafeZone(p) then return false end
    local pvpDis = p:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled")
    if pvpDis ~= nil then return not pvpDis end
    if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return false end
    local pvpAttr = char:GetAttribute("PvP")
    if pvpAttr ~= nil then return pvpAttr end
    local pvpVal = char:FindFirstChild("PvP")
    if pvpVal and pvpVal:IsA("BoolValue") then return pvpVal.Value end
    return true
end
local PlayerLevelCache = {}
local function getLevel(p)
    local cached = PlayerLevelCache[p]
    if cached and cached.data.Parent == p and cached.level.Parent == cached.data then
        local value = cached.level.Value
        if value then return tonumber(value) end
        return 0
    end
    local data = p:FindFirstChild("Data")
    local level = data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
    if data and level then
        PlayerLevelCache[p] = { data = data, level = level }
        local value = level.Value
        if value then return tonumber(value) end
    end
    PlayerLevelCache[p] = nil
    return 0
end
table.insert(Runtime.PlayerLeave, function(leavingPlayer)
    PlayerLevelCache[leavingPlayer] = nil
end)
local function isValid(p)
    if p == player then return false end
    if player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Marines" and p.Team and p.Team == player.Team then return false end
    if p:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == true or p:GetAttribute("IslandRaiding") == true then return false end
    if getLevel(p) < Config.MinPlayerLevel or inSafeZone(p) then return false end
    local char = p.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end
local CharSetupConns = {}
local function clearCharSetupConns()
    for _, c in ipairs(CharSetupConns) do if c then pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end end
    CharSetupConns = {}
end
local function setupChar(char)
    clearCharSetupConns()
    local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if hrp then
        table.insert(CharSetupConns, hrp.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
            if not Runtime.Alive or not Config.AntiStun then return end
            if v:IsA("BodyVelocity") or v:IsA("BodyGyro") or v:IsA("BodyPosition") or v:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") then
                local n = v.Name:lower()
                if (string.find(n, "stun", 1, true) or string.find(n, "freeze", 1, true) or string.find(n, "ragdoll", 1, true) or string.find(n, "knockback", 1, true) or string.find(n, "root", 1, true)) and v.Name ~= "FlyVelocity" and v.Name ~= "FlyGyro" and v.Name ~= "FarmVelocity" then
                    pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if hum and Config.AntiStun then
        pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Stunned, false) end)
        pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false) end)
        pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false) end)
    end
    if Config.AntiStun then pcall(function()
        if not char:FindFirstChild("AntiMover") then
            local f = Instance.new("Folder")
            f.Name = "AntiMover"
            f.Parent = char
        end
        table.insert(CharSetupConns, char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
            if Runtime.Alive and Config.AntiStun and child:IsA("Folder") and child.Name == "AntiMover" then
                local f = Instance.new("Folder")
                f.Name = "AntiMover"
                f.Parent = char
            end
        end))
    end) end
end
if player.Character then setupChar(player.Character) end
local SetupCharConn = Runtime:TrackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupChar))
local function setCanCollideOff(part)
    part.CanCollide = false
end
local function disablePlatformStand(hum)
    hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, false)
end
local function destroyInstance(inst)
    inst:Destroy()
end
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(0.05) do
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then continue end
        if Config.AntiSit then
            local sitHum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if sitHum and sitHum.Sit then sitHum.Sit = false end
            local sitHrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local seatWeldEarly = sitHrp and sitHrp:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld")
            if seatWeldEarly then pcall(destroyInstance, seatWeldEarly) end
        end
        if not Config.AntiStun then continue end
        if char:GetAttribute("UnbreakableAll") ~= true then char:SetAttribute("UnbreakableAll", true) end
        if char:GetAttribute("Stun") ~= 0 then char:SetAttribute("Stun", 0) end
        if char:GetAttribute("CantMove") ~= false then char:SetAttribute("CantMove", false) end
        if char:GetAttribute("Stunned") ~= false then char:SetAttribute("Stunned", false) end
        do
            local hum, hrp = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"), char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp then
                for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.CanCollide then pcall(setCanCollideOff, v) end
                end
                if not Config.Fly then
                    pcall(disablePlatformStand, hum)
                    if hum.PlatformStand then hum.PlatformStand = false end
                end
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                if hrp.Anchored then hrp.Anchored = false end
                for _, v in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                    if (v:IsA("BodyVelocity") or v:IsA("BodyGyro") or v:IsA("BodyPosition")) and v.Name ~= "FlyVelocity" and v.Name ~= "FlyGyro" and v.Name ~= "FarmVelocity" then
                        pcall(destroyInstance, v)
                    end
                end
            end
                end
    end
end)
Runtime.BoatNoclipCache = {}
local function findBoats()
    local boats = {}
    local folder = WS:FindFirstChild("Boats")
    if folder then
        for _, boat in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if boat:IsA("Model") then boats[#boats + 1] = boat end
        end
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(WS:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Name:lower():find("oat", 1, true)
            and obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true) then
            local already = false
            for _, b in ipairs(boats) do
                if b == obj then already = true break end
            end
            if not already then boats[#boats + 1] = obj end
        end
    end
    return boats
end
function Runtime:RestoreBoatNoclip()
    for part, orig in pairs(self.BoatNoclipCache) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = orig end)
        end
        self.BoatNoclipCache[part] = nil
    end
end
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(0.2) do
        if Config.BoatNoclip then
            for _, boat in ipairs(findBoats()) do
                for _, part in ipairs(boat:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if Runtime.BoatNoclipCache[part] == nil then
                            local ok, orig = pcall(function() return part.CanCollide end)
                            if ok then Runtime.BoatNoclipCache[part] = orig end
                        end
                        if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif next(Runtime.BoatNoclipCache) then
            Runtime:RestoreBoatNoclip()
        end
    end
end)
local InputBeganConn = Runtime:TrackConnection(UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if not gp and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if ValidatorRemote then pcall(function() ValidatorRemote:FireServer(math.floor(os.clock() * 1000)) end) end
    end
    if not gp and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
        local kc = input.KeyCode
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Z then Runtime.S.SkillRedirectSkill = 'Z'; LastSkillPressed = 'Z'
        elseif kc == Enum.KeyCode.X then Runtime.S.SkillRedirectSkill = 'X'; LastSkillPressed = 'X'
        elseif kc == Enum.KeyCode.C then Runtime.S.SkillRedirectSkill = 'C'; LastSkillPressed = 'C'
        elseif kc == Enum.KeyCode.V then Runtime.S.SkillRedirectSkill = 'V'; LastSkillPressed = 'V'
        elseif kc == Enum.KeyCode.F then Runtime.S.SkillRedirectSkill = 'F'; LastSkillPressed = 'F' end
        -- v3 model: a redirect is only ARMED for a short window after a skill
        -- keypress. Anything fired at another moment passes through untouched.
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Z or kc == Enum.KeyCode.X or kc == Enum.KeyCode.C
            or kc == Enum.KeyCode.V or kc == Enum.KeyCode.F then
            Runtime.S.SkillKeyTime = os.clock()
        end
    end
end))
if IsMobile then
    Runtime:TrackConnection(UIS.TouchStarted:Connect(function()
        if ValidatorRemote then pcall(function() ValidatorRemote:FireServer(math.floor(os.clock() * 1000)) end) end
    end))
end
local shootFunc, idx = nil, {}
local LIMB_PARTS = { "Head", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "RightLowerArm", "LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "RightLowerLeg" }
local DragonLimbBuffer = {}
local function getRandomLimb(character)
    if not character then return nil end
    table.clear(DragonLimbBuffer)
    for _, name in ipairs(LIMB_PARTS) do
        local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            DragonLimbBuffer[#DragonLimbBuffer+1] = part
        end
    end
    if #DragonLimbBuffer == 0 then return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    return DragonLimbBuffer[math.random(1, #DragonLimbBuffer)]
end
local function initDragon()
    if Runtime.S.DragonReady then return end
    local success = pcall(function()
        local cc = require(RepStorage:WaitForChild("Controllers"):WaitForChild("CombatController"))
        for _, v in ipairs(debug.getupvalues(cc.Attack)) do
            if type(v) == "function" then
                for i, uv in ipairs(debug.getupvalues(v)) do
                    if uv == 727595 then
                        shootFunc = v
                        idx = { u25 = i-3, u21 = i-2, u24 = i-1, u20 = i, u22 = i+1, u23 = i+2, u26 = i+3 }
                        break
                    end
                end
                if shootFunc then break end
            end
        end
    end)
    if success and shootFunc then Runtime.S.DragonReady = true end
end
local function fireShot(pos, hit)
    if not shootFunc then return end
    local u20, u21, u22, u23, u24, u25, u26 = debug.getupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u20), debug.getupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u21), debug.getupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u22), debug.getupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u23), debug.getupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u24), debug.getupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u25), debug.getupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u26)
    local u79 = u25 * u21
    local u80 = (u24 * u21 + u25 * u20) % u22
    u80 = (u80 * u22 + u79) % u23
    u24 = math.floor(u80 / u22)
    u25 = u80 - u24 * u22
    u26 = u26 + 1
    debug.setupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u24, u24)
    debug.setupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u25, u25)
    debug.setupvalue(shootFunc, idx.u26, u26)
    Validator2:FireServer(math.floor(u80 / u23 * 16777215), u26)
    ShootGunEvent:FireServer(pos, { hit })
end
local function isRubberUser(targetPlayer)
    for _, container in ipairs({targetPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack"), targetPlayer.Character}) do
        if container then
            for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if item:GetAttribute("WeaponType") == "Demon Fruit" then
                    local name = item.Name:match("^([^-]+)") or item.Name
                    if name:gsub("%d+$", ""):lower():find("rubber") ~= nil then return true end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function isValidDragonstormTarget(p)
    if p == player then return false end
    if p:GetAttribute("IslandRaiding") == true then return false end
    if player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Marines" and p.Team and p.Team == player.Team then return false end
    if getLevel(p) < Config.MinPlayerLevel then return false end
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    if isRubberUser(p) then return false end
    if not getPVP(p, char) then return false end
    return true
end
local function getNearest()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local myHRP = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return nil end
    local nearest, nearestDist = nil, Config.DragonstormRange
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isValidDragonstormTarget(p) then
            local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local dist = (hrp.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then nearestDist, nearest = dist, hrp end
            end
        end
    end
    if not nearest then
        local seaBeasts = getChildRegistry("SeaBeasts")
        if seaBeasts then
            for _, e in ipairs(seaBeasts) do
                local hrp = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hp = e:FindFirstChild("Health")
                if hrp and hp and hp:IsA("ValueBase") and hp.Value > 0 then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < nearestDist then nearestDist, nearest = dist, hrp end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not nearest then
        local enemies = getChildRegistry("Enemies")
        if enemies then
            for _, e in ipairs(enemies) do
                local hum, hrp = e:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"), e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < nearestDist then nearestDist, nearest = dist, hrp end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nearest
end
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and not Runtime.S.DragonReady do initDragon() task.wait(Config.DragonInitRetryInterval) end
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait() do
        if not Config.DragonstormAura then continue end
        if not player.Character then continue end
        local tool = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if not tool or tool.Name ~= "Dragonstorm" then continue end
        local target = getNearest()
        if target then
            local limb = getRandomLimb(target.Parent) or target
            fireShot(limb.Position, limb)
        end
    end
end)
Runtime.MobBring = {
    Enabled = false,
    Generation = 0,
    Restores = {},
    Cycles = {},
    Velocities = {},
    Returned = {},
    LastPrune = 0,
}
function Runtime.MobBring:Remember(instance, property)
    if not instance then return end
    local restores = self.Restores[instance]
    if not restores then
        restores = {}
        self.Restores[instance] = restores
    end
    if restores[property] == nil then
        local ok, original = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
        if ok then restores[property] = original end
    end
end
function Runtime.MobBring:RestoreInstance(instance)
    if not instance then return end
    local restores = self.Restores[instance]
    if not restores then return end
    if instance.Parent then
        for property, original in pairs(restores) do
            pcall(function() instance[property] = original end)
        end
    end
    self.Restores[instance] = nil
end
function Runtime.MobBring:RestoreAll()
    for root, cycle in pairs(self.Cycles) do
        local mob = cycle.Mob
        local hum = mob and mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if root and root.Parent and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            pcall(function() root.CFrame = cycle.Origin end)
        end
    end
    for root, bv in pairs(self.Velocities) do
        if bv and bv.Parent then pcall(function() bv:Destroy() end) end
    end
    table.clear(self.Velocities)
    for instance, restores in pairs(self.Restores) do
        if instance and instance.Parent then
            for property, original in pairs(restores) do
                pcall(function() instance[property] = original end)
            end
        end
    end
    table.clear(self.Restores)
    table.clear(self.Cycles)
    table.clear(self.Returned)
end
function Runtime.MobBring:Pin(root)
    local bv = self.Velocities[root]
    if bv and bv.Parent then return bv end
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name = "MobBringFreeze"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.Parent = root
    self.Velocities[root] = bv
    Runtime:TrackInstance(bv)
    return bv
end
function Runtime.MobBring:BeginCycle(root, mob, hum, now)
    self.Cycles[root] = {
        Mob = mob,
        Origin = root.CFrame,
        StartedAt = now,
    }
    self:Remember(root, "CanCollide")
    self:Remember(root, "AssemblyLinearVelocity")
    self:Remember(root, "AssemblyAngularVelocity")
    self:Remember(hum, "WalkSpeed")
    self:Remember(hum, "JumpPower")
    self:Pin(root)
end
function Runtime.MobBring:Unpin(root)
    if root == nil then return end
    local bv = self.Velocities[root]
    if bv then
        if bv.Parent then pcall(function() bv:Destroy() end) end
        self.Velocities[root] = nil
    end
end
function Runtime.MobBring:ReturnCycle(root, cycle)
    local mob = cycle.Mob
    local hum = mob and mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if root and root.Parent and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        pcall(function() root.CFrame = cycle.Origin end)
    end
    self:Unpin(root)
    self:RestoreInstance(root)
    if hum then self:RestoreInstance(hum) end
    self.Cycles[root] = nil
    self.Returned[root] = true
end
function Runtime.MobBring:Prune(now)
    if now - self.LastPrune < 1 then return end
    self.LastPrune = now
    for root, cycle in pairs(self.Cycles) do
        if not root or not root.Parent or not cycle.Mob or not cycle.Mob.Parent then
            self.Cycles[root] = nil
        end
    end
    for root, bv in pairs(self.Velocities) do
        if not root or not root.Parent or not bv or not bv.Parent then
            if self.Cycles[root] == nil then
                self.Velocities[root] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    for root in pairs(self.Returned) do
        if not root or not root.Parent then self.Returned[root] = nil end
    end
    for instance in pairs(self.Restores) do
        if not instance or not instance.Parent then self.Restores[instance] = nil end
    end
end
function Runtime.MobBring:Apply()
    local now = os.clock()
    self:Prune(now)
    for root, cycle in pairs(self.Cycles) do
        if now - cycle.StartedAt >= Config.MobBringHold then
            self:ReturnCycle(root, cycle)
        end
    end
    local char = player.Character
    local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local enemies = getChildRegistry("Enemies")
    if not myRoot or not enemies then return end
    local bringCFrame = myRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -15, 0)
    for _, mob in ipairs(enemies) do
        local hum = mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or mob.PrimaryPart
        local inRange = hum and root and hum.Health > 0
            and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= Config.MobBringRange
        if not inRange then
            if root then self.Returned[root] = nil end
        elseif not self.Returned[root] then
            local owned = true
            if isnetworkowner then
                owned = isnetworkowner(root)
            else
                owned = root.ReceiveAge == 0 and not root.Anchored
            end
            if not owned then continue end
            local cycle = self.Cycles[root]
            if not cycle then
                self:BeginCycle(root, mob, hum, now)
            end
            self:Pin(root)
            root.CanCollide = false
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hum.WalkSpeed = 0
            hum.JumpPower = 0
            root.CFrame = bringCFrame
        end
    end
end
function Runtime.MobBring:Start()
    if self.Enabled then return end
    self.Enabled = true
    self.Generation = self.Generation + 1
    local generation = self.Generation
    pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge) end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while Runtime.Alive and self.Enabled and self.Generation == generation do
            self:Apply()
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end
function Runtime.MobBring:Stop()
    self.Enabled = false
    self.Generation = self.Generation + 1
    self:RestoreAll()
end
Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals = {}
Runtime.S.NoclipThread = nil
Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns = {}
Runtime.S.NoclipGen = 0
Runtime.S.Clip = true
Runtime.S.NoclipUserWant = Config.Noclip == true
Runtime.S.NoclipWalkFlingWant = false
Runtime.S.NoclipActive = false
Runtime.S.NoclipWorker = false
Runtime.S.floatName = "HumanoidRootPart"
local function trackPart(part)
    if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= Runtime.S.floatName then
        if Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals[part] == nil then
            Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals[part] = part.CanCollide
        end
        part.CanCollide = false
    end
end
local function untrackPart(part)
    if Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals[part] == nil then return end
    if part and part.Parent then
        part.CanCollide = Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals[part]
    end
    Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals[part] = nil
end
local function stopNoclip()
    Runtime.S.NoclipGen = Runtime.S.NoclipGen + 1
    if Runtime.S.NoclipThread then task.cancel(Runtime.S.NoclipThread) Runtime.S.NoclipThread = nil end
    for _, c in ipairs(Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns) do c:Disconnect() end
    Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns = {}
    Runtime.S.Clip = true
    task.wait(0.1)
    for part, orig in pairs(Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals) do
        if typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent then
            part.CanCollide = orig
        end
    end
    Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals = {}
    Runtime.S.NoclipActive = false
end
local function startNoclip()
    if Runtime.S.NoclipThread then Runtime.S.NoclipActive = true return end
    if not Runtime.S.Clip or next(Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals) then
        stopNoclip()
    end
    if not (Runtime.S.NoclipUserWant or Runtime.S.NoclipWalkFlingWant) then return end
    Runtime.S.NoclipGen = Runtime.S.NoclipGen + 1
    local myGen = Runtime.S.NoclipGen
    Runtime.S.Clip = false
    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do trackPart(child) end
        local ca = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if Runtime.S.NoclipGen ~= myGen then return end
            trackPart(child)
        end)
        local cr = char.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(child)
            if Runtime.S.NoclipGen ~= myGen then return end
            untrackPart(child)
        end)
        table.insert(Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns, ca)
        table.insert(Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns, cr)
    end
    table.insert(Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
        task.wait(1)
        if Runtime.S.NoclipGen ~= myGen then return end
        for _, child in ipairs(newChar:GetDescendants()) do trackPart(child) end
        local ca2 = newChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if Runtime.S.NoclipGen ~= myGen then return end
            trackPart(child)
        end)
        local cr2 = newChar.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(child)
            if Runtime.S.NoclipGen ~= myGen then return end
            untrackPart(child)
        end)
        table.insert(Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns, ca2)
        table.insert(Runtime.S.NoclipCharConns, cr2)
    end))
    Runtime.S.NoclipThread = task.spawn(function()
        while Runtime.Alive and not Runtime.S.Clip do
            -- InfY-style re-apply: every physics step instead of a 0.1s poll, so
            -- collision can never be re-enabled between passes. Stepped:Wait()
            -- (not Stepped:Connect) keeps this inside the cancellable thread, so
            -- stopNoclip's task.cancel still tears it down with no leaked
            -- connection. Restoration still uses the original CanCollide cached
            -- above -- InfY blindly forces true, which solidifies parts that
            -- were never solid in the first place.
            RS.Stepped:Wait()
            for part, _ in pairs(Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals) do
                if part.Parent then
                    if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
                else
                    Runtime.S.NoclipOriginals[part] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    Runtime.S.NoclipActive = true
end
function Runtime:SyncNoclip()
    if Runtime.S.NoclipWorker then return end
    Runtime.S.NoclipWorker = true
    task.spawn(function()
        -- One serialized reconcile loop: start/stop may yield (stop waits 0.1s
        -- for physics), and a toggle flip during that window must be re-read on
        -- the next pass instead of spawning a second lifecycle. pcall guarantees
        -- the worker flag always resets so a transient error cannot wedge noclip.
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            while Runtime.Alive do
                local want = Runtime.S.NoclipUserWant or Runtime.S.NoclipWalkFlingWant
                if want == Runtime.S.NoclipActive then break end
                if want then startNoclip() else stopNoclip() end
            end
        end)
        Runtime.S.NoclipWorker = false
        if not ok then warn("[Hub] Noclip reconcile error: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end)
end
-- ============================================================
--  WALK FLING  (faithful port of InfY's walkfling)
-- ============================================================
-- Mechanism, exactly as InfY does it: every Heartbeat slam the root velocity to
-- vel * 10000 + (0, 10000, 0), restore it on RenderStepped (before physics
-- integrates the move) and add a tiny +0.1 Y nudge on Stepped to keep brushing
-- against the victim. The contact solver still consumes the spike, so the huge
-- impulse lands on whatever we touch while we ourselves barely move. noclip is
-- mandatory: without it geometry stops us making contact at all.
-- NOTE: InfY re-initialises `movel` to 0.1 on every pass, so its "alternating"
-- nudge is in fact always +0.1 upward. Kept as-is on purpose (exact port);
-- hoist `movel` above the repeat to get a true +/- alternation.
Runtime.WalkFling = { Thread = nil, Gen = 0, Conn = nil, Died = nil, Active = false }
function Runtime.WalkFling:Stop(preserveNoclip)
    local wf = Runtime.WalkFling
    wf.Active = false
    wf.Gen = wf.Gen + 1
    if wf.Thread then task.cancel(wf.Thread) wf.Thread = nil end
    if wf.Conn then wf.Conn:Disconnect() wf.Conn = nil end
    if wf.Died then wf.Died:Disconnect() wf.Died = nil end
    -- Walk Fling owns only its noclip request. Release it on a real stop, but
    -- preserve it across Start()'s internal reset so restarting never bounces
    -- the shared engine. The user-facing Noclip toggle is never flipped.
    if not preserveNoclip then
        Runtime.S.NoclipWalkFlingWant = false
        Runtime:SyncNoclip()
    end
end
function Runtime.WalkFling:Start()
    Runtime.WalkFling:Stop(true)
    local wf = Runtime.WalkFling
    wf.Active = true
    wf.Gen = wf.Gen + 1
    local myGen = wf.Gen
    -- InfY starts with execCmd("noclip nonotify"); keep that behaviour without
    -- taking ownership of the user-facing Noclip toggle.
    Runtime.S.NoclipWalkFlingWant = true
    Runtime:SyncNoclip()
    local function hookDeath()
        local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        wf.Died = hum.Died:Connect(function()
            pcall(function() Runtime.WalkFling:Stop() end)
            -- InfY has no toggle to keep honest; we do. Death stops the fling
            -- (InfY's Died handler runs "unwalkfling"), so reflect that in the UI
            -- instead of leaving the switch on while nothing runs.
            if Toggles and Toggles.WalkFling and Toggles.WalkFling.Value then
                pcall(function() Toggles.WalkFling:SetValue(false) end)
            end
        end)
    end
    hookDeath()
    wf.Conn = Runtime:TrackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(1)
        if not wf.Active or wf.Gen ~= myGen then return end
        Runtime:SyncNoclip()
        if wf.Died then wf.Died:Disconnect() wf.Died = nil end
        hookDeath()
    end))
    wf.Thread = task.spawn(function()
        repeat
            RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if not (Runtime.Alive and wf.Active and wf.Gen == myGen) then break end
            local character = player.Character
            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local vel, movel = nil, 0.1
            while not (character and character.Parent and root and root.Parent) do
                RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
                if not (Runtime.Alive and wf.Active and wf.Gen == myGen) then return end
                character = player.Character
                root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            end
            vel = root.Velocity
            -- Walkfling force (owner-set 9e30; was InfY's 10000).
            root.Velocity = vel * 9e30 + Vector3.new(0, 9e30, 0)
            RS.RenderStepped:Wait()
            if character and character.Parent and root and root.Parent then
                root.Velocity = vel
            end
            RS.Stepped:Wait()
            if character and character.Parent and root and root.Parent then
                root.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                movel = movel * -1
            end
        until not (wf.Active and wf.Gen == myGen)
    end)
end
local FlyC, bv, bg = nil, nil, nil
Runtime.MobileFly = {
    Thread = nil, Conn = nil, Up = false, Down = false, SpeedLevel = 1,
    Attachment = nil, LinearVelocity = nil, AlignOrientation = nil,
    Character = nil, Humanoid = nil, Root = nil, Animate = nil, LockedTracks = {}, Controls = nil,
}
local MobFlyStates = {
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running, Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, Enum.HumanoidStateType.StrafingNoPhysics,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,
}
local function stopFly()
    local mf = Runtime.MobileFly
    if mf.Thread then task.cancel(mf.Thread) mf.Thread = nil end
    if mf.Conn then Runtime:UntrackConnection(mf.Conn); mf.Conn:Disconnect(); mf.Conn = nil end
    mf.Up, mf.Down = false, false
    if FlyC then FlyC:Disconnect() FlyC = nil end
    if mf.LinearVelocity then mf.LinearVelocity:Destroy(); mf.LinearVelocity = nil end
    if mf.AlignOrientation then mf.AlignOrientation:Destroy(); mf.AlignOrientation = nil end
    if mf.Attachment then mf.Attachment:Destroy(); mf.Attachment = nil end
    for _, track in ipairs(mf.LockedTracks) do pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(1) end) end
    table.clear(mf.LockedTracks)
    if mf.Animate then mf.Animate.Disabled = false; mf.Animate = nil end
    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if char:GetAttribute("SamiHubFlyArmed") then char:SetAttribute("SamiHubFlyArmed", nil) end
        if hum then
            hum.PlatformStand = false
            for _, state in ipairs(MobFlyStates) do hum:SetStateEnabled(state, true) end
            pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            local oBv, oBg = hrp:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity"), hrp:FindFirstChild("FlyGyro")
            if oBv then oBv:Destroy() end if oBg then oBg:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    mf.Character, mf.Humanoid, mf.Root = nil, nil, nil
    bv, bg = nil, nil
end
local function startFly()
    stopFly()
    if IsMobile then
        local mf = Runtime.MobileFly
        local ok, controls = pcall(function()
            local module = require(player.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule"))
            return module:GetControls()
        end)
        mf.Controls = ok and controls or nil
        local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        mf.Character, mf.Humanoid, mf.Root = char, hum, root
        mf.Animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if mf.Animate then mf.Animate.Disabled = true end
        table.clear(mf.LockedTracks)
        for _, track in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(0) end)
            mf.LockedTracks[#mf.LockedTracks + 1] = track
        end
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        mf.Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        mf.Attachment.Parent = root
        mf.LinearVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
        mf.LinearVelocity.MaxForce = 9e9
        mf.LinearVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
        mf.LinearVelocity.Attachment0 = mf.Attachment
        mf.LinearVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
        mf.LinearVelocity.Parent = mf.Attachment
        mf.AlignOrientation = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
        mf.AlignOrientation.MaxTorque = 9e9
        mf.AlignOrientation.Responsiveness = 200
        mf.AlignOrientation.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
        mf.AlignOrientation.Attachment0 = mf.Attachment
        mf.AlignOrientation.Parent = mf.Attachment
        mf.Conn = Runtime:TrackConnection(RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not Runtime.Alive or not Config.Fly then stopFly(); return end
            local camera = WS.CurrentCamera
            if not camera or not mf.Root or not mf.Root.Parent or not mf.LinearVelocity or not mf.AlignOrientation then return end
            for _, track in ipairs(mf.LockedTracks) do
                if track and track.IsPlaying and track.Speed ~= 0 then pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(0) end) end
            end
            local moveVector = mf.Controls and mf.Controls:GetMoveVector() or mf.Humanoid.MoveDirection
            local direction = Vector3.zero
            if moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
                direction = (camera.CFrame.LookVector * -moveVector.Z) + (camera.CFrame.RightVector * moveVector.X)
            end
            if direction.Magnitude > 0 then direction = direction.Unit end
            local lift = (mf.Up and 1 or 0) - (mf.Down and 1 or 0)
            local busySpeed = Config.MobileFlySpeed
            if Runtime.S.FlyBusy then busySpeed = Config.FlyBusySpeed end
            mf.LinearVelocity.VectorVelocity = (direction * busySpeed * mf.SpeedLevel)
                + Vector3.new(0, lift * Config.MobileFlyVerticalSpeed, 0)
            mf.AlignOrientation.CFrame = camera.CFrame
        end))
        return
    end
    FlyC = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Runtime.Alive or not Config.Fly then stopFly() return end
        local char = player.Character if not char then return end
        local hrp, hum = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end
        if not bv or not bv.Parent then
            bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            bv.Parent = hrp
            bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            bg.Name = "FlyGyro"
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.P = Config.FlyGyroStiffness
            bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
