            bg.Parent = hrp
            hum.PlatformStand = true
        end
        local cam = WS.CurrentCamera.CFrame
        local f = (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) and 1 or 0) + (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) and -1 or 0)
        local r = (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) and 1 or 0) + (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) and -1 or 0)
        local dir = (cam.LookVector * f) + (cam.RightVector * r)
        if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end
        local lift = (Runtime.MobileFly.Up and 1 or 0) - (Runtime.MobileFly.Down and 1 or 0)
        local flySpeed = Config.FlySpeed
        if Runtime.S.FlyBusy then flySpeed = Config.FlyBusySpeed end
        bv.Velocity = (dir * flySpeed * Runtime.MobileFly.SpeedLevel) + Vector3.new(0, lift * flySpeed, 0)
        bg.CFrame = cam
    end)
end
Runtime.S.FlyBusy = false
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait() do
        pcall(function()
            local char = player.Character
            if not char or not char.Parent then return end
            local busyFlag = char:FindFirstChild("Busy")
            Runtime.S.FlyBusy = (busyFlag and busyFlag.Value) and true or false
        end)
    end
end)
local FlyRespawnConn = Runtime:TrackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(Config.FlyRespawnDelay) if Config.Fly then startFly() end end))
Runtime:TrackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if Runtime.S.ActiveTween then Runtime.S.ActiveTween:Cancel() Runtime.S.ActiveTween = nil end
    Runtime.S.InstaActive = false
end))
local InfJumpLast = 0
local SkyjumpFns, SkyjumpFnsSky, SkyjumpJumped, SkyjumpLastUseTbl = {}, nil, nil, nil
local function probeLastUse(t) return t.LastUse end
local function forceLastUseZero(t) t.LastUse = 0 end
local function resetSkyjumpUpvalues(char)
    if not (char and getgc and getupvalues and setupvalue) then return end
    local sky = char:FindFirstChild("Skyjump")
    if not sky then return end
    if SkyjumpFnsSky ~= sky or #SkyjumpFns == 0 then
        SkyjumpFnsSky = sky
        SkyjumpFns = {}
        SkyjumpJumped = nil
        SkyjumpLastUseTbl = nil
        for _, fn in next, getgc() do
            if typeof(fn) == "function" then
                local ok, env = pcall(getfenv, fn)
                if ok and env and env.script == sky then
                    SkyjumpFns[#SkyjumpFns + 1] = fn
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, fn in ipairs(SkyjumpFns) do
        local hasLastUse = false
        for i, uv in next, getupvalues(fn) do
            if type(uv) == "table" then
                local okLU, luVal = pcall(probeLastUse, uv)
                if okLU and luVal ~= nil then
                    pcall(forceLastUseZero, uv)
                    SkyjumpLastUseTbl = uv
                    hasLastUse = true
                end
            elseif type(uv) == "number" and uv >= 5 and uv <= 100 then
                pcall(setupvalue, fn, i, 0)
            end
        end
        if hasLastUse and not SkyjumpJumped then
            SkyjumpJumped = fn
        end
    end
end
local function doInfiniteJump()
    if not Config.InfiniteJump then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - InfJumpLast < 0.05 then return end
    InfJumpLast = now
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.Sit then return end
    pcall(resetSkyjumpUpvalues, char)
    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
    if SkyjumpJumped then
        local before = SkyjumpLastUseTbl and select(2, pcall(probeLastUse, SkyjumpLastUseTbl))
        pcall(SkyjumpJumped, { UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin })
        local after = SkyjumpLastUseTbl and select(2, pcall(probeLastUse, SkyjumpLastUseTbl))
        if before ~= after then
            return
        end
    end
    local mult = Config.InfJumpMultiplier
    local jp = 50
    if hum.UseJumpPower then
        jp = hum.JumpPower
    else
        jp = math.sqrt(math.max(hum.JumpHeight or 7.2, 0) * 2 * WS.Gravity)
    end
    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, math.max(jp * mult, 50), vel.Z)
    pcall(function()
        local energy = char:FindFirstChild("Energy")
        local cost = 15
        if energy and energy.Value >= cost then
            CommE:FireServer("Dodge", "Geppo", cost, nil, WS:GetServerTimeNow())
            local skyEv = RepStorage:FindFirstChild("PlayerSkyJumped")
            if skyEv then skyEv:Fire() end
        end
    end)
end
Runtime:TrackConnection(UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(doInfiniteJump))
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive do
        if Config.InfiniteJump then
            pcall(resetSkyjumpUpvalues, player.Character)
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)
Runtime.MiscFX = { Conns = {}, WaterThread = nil, GhostConn = nil }
local function miscClearConns()
    for _, c in ipairs(Runtime.MiscFX.Conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(Runtime.MiscFX.Conns)
end
local function miscBindCharacter(char)
    miscClearConns()
    if not Config.RemoveAnimations or not char then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum or not Runtime.Alive or not Config.RemoveAnimations then return end
        local animator = hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
        if not animator then return end
        for _, t in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do t:Stop() end
        Runtime.MiscFX.Conns[#Runtime.MiscFX.Conns + 1] = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(t)
            t:Stop()
        end)
    end)
end
local function miscRestoreAnimations()
    miscClearConns()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    pcall(function()
        local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then
            local restarted = animate:Clone()
            animate:Destroy()
            restarted.Parent = char
        end
    end)
end
local function miscSetGhostShip(enabled)
    if Runtime.MiscFX.GhostConn then
        Runtime:UntrackConnection(Runtime.MiscFX.GhostConn)
        Runtime.MiscFX.GhostConn:Disconnect()
        Runtime.MiscFX.GhostConn = nil
    end
    if not enabled then return end
    pcall(function()
        local map = WS:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local interior = map and map:FindFirstChild("GhostShipInterior")
        if interior then
            for _, v in ipairs(interior:GetChildren()) do
                if v.Name ~= "Teleport" and v.Name ~= "TeleportSpawn" then v:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        if map then
            Runtime.MiscFX.GhostConn = Runtime:TrackConnection(map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child.Name == "GhostShipInterior" then
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if Config.RemoveGhostShip then miscSetGhostShip(true) end
                end
            end))
        end
    end)
end
local function miscSetWater(enabled)
    if Runtime.MiscFX.WaterThread then
        task.cancel(Runtime.MiscFX.WaterThread)
        Runtime.MiscFX.WaterThread = nil
    end
    local function setWaterSize(y)
        pcall(function()
            local map = WS:FindFirstChild("Map")
            local water = map and map:FindFirstChild("WaterBase-Plane")
            if water then water.Size = Vector3.new(1000, y, 1000) end
        end)
    end
    if enabled then
        Runtime.MiscFX.WaterThread = task.spawn(function()
            while Runtime.Alive and Config.WalkOnWater do
                setWaterSize(112)
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    else
        setWaterSize(80)
    end
end
local function miscRemoveWater(enabled)
    -- Destroys the sea plane outright (owner request; defaults ON so it is gone
    -- from the first frame). NOTE: this is one-way for the session -- a destroyed
    -- part cannot be restored, so flipping the toggle off will NOT bring the
    -- water back; only rejoining will. While it is on, Walk On Water does
    -- nothing (its lookup is FindFirstChild + nil check, so it no-ops safely
    -- instead of erroring).
    if not enabled then return end
    pcall(function()
        local map = WS:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local water = map and map:FindFirstChild("WaterBase-Plane")
        if water then water:Destroy() end
    end)
end
local function applyCameraZoom()
    -- OWNER REQUIREMENT (always-on): infinite zoom + no water, every run.
    pcall(function()
        player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = math.huge
        player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
    end)
end
Runtime:TrackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.wait(0.5)
    if not Runtime.Alive then return end
    if Config.RemoveAnimations then miscBindCharacter(char) end
    applyCameraZoom()
    pcall(function()
        local map = WS:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local water = map and map:FindFirstChild("WaterBase-Plane")
        if water then water:Destroy() end
    end)
end))
if Config.RemoveGhostShip then miscSetGhostShip(true) end
if Config.WalkOnWater then miscSetWater(true) end
-- OWNER REQUIREMENT (always-on): water plane is ALWAYS destroyed at boot,
-- regardless of the RemoveWater toggle. Toggle-off cannot restore it anyway.
pcall(function()
    local map = WS:FindFirstChild("Map")
    local water = map and map:FindFirstChild("WaterBase-Plane")
    if water then water:Destroy() end
end)
if Config.RemoveWater then miscRemoveWater(true) end
applyCameraZoom()
local Features = {}
local function makeLooper(interval, condition, body, onStop, skipWhenDisabled)
    local gen, thread = 0, nil
    local running = false
    local function stop()
        gen = gen + 1
        running = false
        if thread and thread ~= coroutine.running() then task.cancel(thread) end
        thread = nil
        if onStop then pcall(onStop) end
    end
    local function start()
        stop()
        gen = gen + 1
        local myGen = gen
        running = true
        thread = task.spawn(function()
            while Runtime.Alive and gen == myGen do
                local waitTime = type(interval) == "function" and interval() or interval
                task.wait(waitTime)
                if not Runtime.Alive or gen ~= myGen then break end
                if condition() then
                    local ok, err = pcall(body)
                    if not ok then warn("[Looper] " .. tostring(err)) end
                elseif not skipWhenDisabled then
                    stop()
                    break
                end
            end
            running = false
        end)
    end
    return { Start = start, Stop = stop, Active = function() return running end }
end
Features.Haki = makeLooper(
    function() return Config.HakiCheckInterval end,
    function() return Config.AutoHaki end,
    function()
        local c = player.Character
        if c and not c:FindFirstChild("HasBuso") then
            pcall(function() CommF:InvokeServer("Buso") end)
        end
    end
)
Features.Ken = makeLooper(
    function() return Config.KenCheckInterval end,
    function() return Config.AutoKen end,
    function() pcall(function() CommE:FireServer("Ken", true) end) end
)
Features.PvP = makeLooper(
    function() return Config.PvPEnableInterval end,
    function() return Config.AutoPvP end,
    function() pcall(function() CommF:InvokeServer("EnablePvp") end) end
)
local function findAwakeningTool()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local inChar = char:FindFirstChild("Awakening")
    if inChar then return inChar end
    local bp = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    return bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Awakening")
end
Features.V4 = makeLooper(
    nil,
    function() return Config.AutoV4 end,
    function()
        if os.clock() - Runtime.S.lastV4 < Config.V4Cooldown then return end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        local stun = char:FindFirstChild("Stun")
        if stun and stun.Value > 0 then return end
        local busy = char:FindFirstChild("Busy")
        if busy and busy.Value then return end
        local energy = char:FindFirstChild("RaceEnergy")
        if energy and energy.Value < 1 then return end
        local transformed = char:FindFirstChild("RaceTransformed")
        if transformed and transformed.Value then return end
        local tool = findAwakeningTool()
        if not tool then return end
        local remote = tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteFunction")
        if not remote then return end
        remote:InvokeServer(true)
        Runtime.S.lastV4 = os.clock()
    end
)
Features.V3 = makeLooper(
    function() return Config.V3CheckInterval end,
    function() return Config.AutoV3 end,
    function() pcall(function() CommE:FireServer("ActivateAbility") end) end
)
local stopPanicFlee
local function getPanicFleePos()
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    if placeId == 4442272183 or placeId == 79091703265657 then
        return Vector3.new(923, 126, 32852)
    elseif placeId == 7449423635 or placeId == 100117331123089 then
        return Vector3.new(-5097.93164, 316.447021, -3142.66602)
    end
    return nil
end
local function startPanicFlee()
    stopPanicFlee()
    Runtime.S.PanicFleeGen = Runtime.S.PanicFleeGen + 1
    Runtime.S.PanicFleeRunning = true
end
stopPanicFlee = function()
    Runtime.S.PanicFleeGen = Runtime.S.PanicFleeGen + 1
    Runtime.S.PanicFleeRunning = false
end
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(0.05) do
        if not (Config.PanicFlee and Runtime.S.PanicFleeRunning) then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then continue end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.MaxHealth <= 0 then continue end
        if hum.Health > Config.PanicFleeResetHealth then
            Runtime.S.PanicFleeOnCooldown = false
        end
        if Runtime.S.PanicFleeOnCooldown then continue end
        if hum.Health >= Config.PanicFleeHealthThreshold then continue end
        if os.clock() < Runtime.S.PanicFleeNextRun then continue end
        local pos = getPanicFleePos()
        if not pos then continue end
        for i = 1, Config.PanicFleeAttempts do
            -- requestEntrance REMOVED (the remote is patched): the pause is kept
            -- and the loop left intact so re-adding the escape is a one-line
            -- change -- see backups/requestEntrance_removed_from_DEV.lua
            -- (DEV block 2). Until then PanicFlee cannot move the character.
            if pauseTwn then pauseTwn(0.5) end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        Runtime.S.PanicFleeOnCooldown = true
        Runtime.S.PanicFleeNextRun = os.clock() + Config.PanicFleeCooldown
    end
end)
Runtime.S.ESPObjects, Runtime.S.ESPMap = {}, {}
Runtime.S.ESPPlayerConns = {}
Runtime.S.ESPPlayerData = {}
local function getESPPlayerData(p)
    if not p then return { level = "?", fruit = "None", bounty = 0 } end
    local data = Runtime.S.ESPPlayerData[p]
    if not data then
        data = { level = "?", fruit = "None", bounty = 0, lastUpdate = 0 }
        Runtime.S.ESPPlayerData[p] = data
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - data.lastUpdate > 5 then
        pcall(function() data.level = p.Data.Level.Value end)
        pcall(function() data.fruit = tostring(p.Data.DevilFruit.Value) end)
        pcall(function()
            local ls = p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            local bh = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Bounty/Honor")
            data.bounty = bh and bh.Value or 0
        end)
        data.lastUpdate = now
    end
    return data
end
local function espShortNumber(n)
    if n >= 1e9 then return ("%.1fB"):format(n / 1e9)
    elseif n >= 1e6 then return ("%.1fM"):format(n / 1e6)
    elseif n >= 1e3 then return ("%.1fK"):format(n / 1e3)
    end
    return tostring(n)
end
local function removeESPForTarget(target)
    if not target then return end
    for i = #Runtime.S.ESPObjects, 1, -1 do
        local data = Runtime.S.ESPObjects[i]
        if data.target == target then
            if data.billboard then
                Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.billboard)
                pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end)
            end
            if data.highlight then
                Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.highlight)
                pcall(function() data.highlight:Destroy() end)
            end
            Runtime.S.ESPMap[target] = nil
            table.remove(Runtime.S.ESPObjects, i)
        end
    end
end
local function clearESP()
    for _, obj in ipairs(Runtime.S.ESPObjects) do
        if obj then
            if obj.billboard then
                Runtime:UntrackInstance(obj.billboard)
                pcall(function() obj.billboard:Destroy() end)
            end
            if obj.highlight then
                Runtime:UntrackInstance(obj.highlight)
                pcall(function() obj.highlight:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    Runtime.S.ESPObjects, Runtime.S.ESPMap = {}, {}
end
local function createESP(target, targetPlayer)
    if not Runtime.Alive then return end
    local head = target:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    if not Runtime.S.ESPMap[target] then
        local stale = head:FindFirstChild("NeonESP")
        if stale then pcall(function() stale:Destroy() end) end
    end
    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = "NeonESP"
    bb.Adornee = head
    bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, Config.ESPSizeX, 0, Config.ESPTextSize + 14)
    bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, Config.ESPStudsOffset, 0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.Parent = head
    Runtime:TrackInstance(bb)
    local espColor, strokeColor
    if targetPlayer then
        if IsAlly(targetPlayer) then
            espColor = Color3.fromRGB(104, 211, 245)
            strokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(27, 25, 38)
        else
            espColor = Color3.fromRGB(237, 233, 254)
            strokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(27, 25, 38)
        end
    else
        espColor = Color3.fromRGB(237, 233, 254)
        strokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(27, 25, 38)
    end
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -8)
    lbl.Text = target.Name
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = Config.ESPTextSize
    lbl.TextColor3 = espColor
    lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = strokeColor
    lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    lbl.RichText = true
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.Parent = bb
    local es = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    es.Color = strokeColor
    es.Thickness = 1
    es.Transparency = 0.2
    es.Parent = lbl
    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Name = "HealthBar"
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
    bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 3)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 1, -4)
    bar.Parent = bb
    local bcorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    bcorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    bcorner.Parent = bar
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Name = "Fill"
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 80)
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.Parent = bar
    local fcorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fcorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fcorner.Parent = fill
    local hum = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    Runtime.S.ESPMap[target] = true
    table.insert(Runtime.S.ESPObjects, { billboard = bb, label = lbl, barFill = fill, head = head, hum = hum, hrp = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), target = target, player = targetPlayer, name = target.Name, maxHp = hum and hum.MaxHealth or 0, highlight = nil, lastText = "" })
end
local function syncESP()
    if not Config.ESP then return end
    for i = #Runtime.S.ESPObjects, 1, -1 do
        local d = Runtime.S.ESPObjects[i]
        if not d.target or not d.target.Parent or not d.head or not d.head.Parent or not d.hrp or not d.hrp.Parent
            or not d.billboard or not d.billboard.Parent then
            if d.billboard then
                Runtime:UntrackInstance(d.billboard)
                d.billboard:Destroy()
            end
            if d.highlight then
                Runtime:UntrackInstance(d.highlight)
                pcall(function() d.highlight:Destroy() end)
            end
            Runtime.S.ESPMap[d.target] = nil
            table.remove(Runtime.S.ESPObjects, i)
            continue
        end
        if not d.hum or not d.hum.Parent then d.hum = d.target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
        if d.hum then d.maxHp = d.hum.MaxHealth end
    end
    local function checkAdd(c, p)
        if c and c:FindFirstChild("Head") and not Runtime.S.ESPMap[c] then createESP(c, p) end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Character then checkAdd(p.Character, p) end
    end
end
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(Config.ESPUpdateInterval) do
        if Config.ESP then
            pcall(function()
            local mC, mH = player.Character, player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if mH then
                for _, d in ipairs(Runtime.S.ESPObjects) do
                    if d.billboard and d.billboard.Parent and d.hrp and d.hrp.Parent then
                        local dist = math.floor((mH.Position - d.hrp.Position).Magnitude)
                        local inRange = dist <= Config.ESPMaxDistance
                        if d.billboard.Enabled ~= inRange then d.billboard.Enabled = inRange end
                        if not inRange then continue end
                        local hum = d.hum and d.hum.Parent and d.hum or nil
                        if not hum and d.target.Parent then
                            hum = d.target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            d.hum = hum
                        end
                        local distQ = dist
                        local kenActive, dodges, maxDodges = false, 0, 0
                        if hum then
                            local plr = d.player and d.player.Parent == Players and d.player
                            if plr then
                                local ka = plr:GetAttribute("KenActive")
                                if ka ~= nil then
                                    kenActive = ka and true or false
                                    dodges = plr:GetAttribute("KenDodgesLeft") or 0
                                    maxDodges = plr:GetAttribute("KenMaxDodges") or 0
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        local extrasKey = nil
                        if Config.ESPShowLevel or Config.ESPShowBounty or Config.ESPShowFruit or Config.ESPShowPvP then
                            local pd = getESPPlayerData(d.player)
                            local pvpOn = d.player and d.player.Parent == Players and d.player:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") ~= true
                            extrasKey = table.concat({
                                Config.ESPShowLevel and tostring(pd.level) or "",
                                Config.ESPShowBounty and espShortNumber(pd.bounty) or "",
                                Config.ESPShowFruit and tostring(pd.fruit) or "",
                                Config.ESPShowPvP and (pvpOn and "1" or "0") or "",
                            }, "|")
                        end
                        if d.lastDistQ ~= distQ or d.lastKenActive ~= kenActive
                            or d.lastDodges ~= dodges or d.lastMaxDodges ~= maxDodges
                            or d.lastExtras ~= extrasKey then
                            local kR, kG, kB = 255, 165, 0
                            if not kenActive then kR, kG, kB = 120, 120, 126 end
                            local text = string.format("<font color='rgb(237,233,254)'>%s</font>  <font color='rgb(168,85,247)'>%dm</font>",
                                d.name, distQ)
                            if hum then
                                text = text .. string.format("  <font color='rgb(%d,%d,%d)'>KEN %d/%d</font>",
                                    kR, kG, kB, dodges, maxDodges)
                            end
                            local lines = 1
                            if extrasKey then
                                local pd = getESPPlayerData(d.player)
                                local info = {}
                                if Config.ESPShowLevel then
                                    info[#info + 1] = string.format("<font color='rgb(168,85,247)'>Lv.%s</font>", tostring(pd.level))
                                end
                                if Config.ESPShowBounty then
                                    local bountyColor = "rgb(255,215,0)"
                                    if d.player and d.player.Team then
                                        local teamName = d.player.Team.Name
                                        if teamName == "Pirates" then
                                            bountyColor = "rgb(255,80,80)"
                                        elseif teamName == "Marines" then
                                            bountyColor = "rgb(80,160,255)"
                                        end
                                    end
                                    info[#info + 1] = string.format("<font color='%s'>%s</font>", bountyColor, espShortNumber(pd.bounty))
                                end
                                if Config.ESPShowPvP then
                                    local pvpOn = d.player and d.player.Parent == Players and d.player:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") ~= true
                                    if pvpOn then
                                        info[#info + 1] = "<font color='rgb(255,80,80)'>PvP</font>"
                                    else
                                        info[#info + 1] = "<font color='rgb(80,255,120)'>PvP Off</font>"
                                    end
                                end
                                if #info > 0 then
                                    text = text .. "\n" .. table.concat(info, "  ")
                                    lines = lines + 1
                                end
                                if Config.ESPShowFruit then
                                    text = text .. string.format("\n<font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>%s</font>", tostring(pd.fruit))
                                    lines = lines + 1
                                end
                            end
                            d.billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, Config.ESPSizeX, 0,
                                Config.ESPTextSize + 14 + (lines - 1) * (Config.ESPTextSize + 2))
                            d.label.Text = text
                            d.lastDistQ, d.lastKenActive = distQ, kenActive
                            d.lastDodges, d.lastMaxDodges = dodges, maxDodges
                            d.lastExtras = extrasKey
                        end
                        if Config.ESPHighlight then
                            if not d.highlight or not d.highlight.Parent then
                                local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                                hl.Name = "SamiHubESPHighlight"
                                hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                                hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
                                hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                                hl.Parent = d.target
                                Runtime:TrackInstance(hl)
                                d.highlight = hl
                            end
                            d.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(Config.ESPColorR, Config.ESPColorG, Config.ESPColorB)
                            d.highlight.OutlineColor = d.highlight.FillColor
                        elseif d.highlight then
                            Runtime:UntrackInstance(d.highlight)
                            pcall(function() d.highlight:Destroy() end)
                            d.highlight = nil
                        end
                        if hum and d.barFill then
                            local hp = math.clamp(hum.Health, 0, hum.MaxHealth)
                            if hum.MaxHealth > d.maxHp then d.maxHp = hum.MaxHealth end
                            local pct = d.maxHp > 0 and hp / d.maxHp or 0
                            if not d.lastPct or pct - d.lastPct > 0.01 or d.lastPct - pct > 0.01 then
                                d.barFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                                d.lastPct = pct
                            end
                            local band = pct > 0.6 and 3 or (pct > 0.3 and 2 or 1)
                            if d.lastBand ~= band then
                                if band == 3 then d.barFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 80)
                                elseif band == 2 then d.barFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                else d.barFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) end
                                d.lastBand = band
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            end)
        end
    end
end)
local function bindESPPlayer(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == player or Runtime.S.ESPPlayerConns[targetPlayer] then return end
    local conns = {}
    Runtime.S.ESPPlayerConns[targetPlayer] = conns
    conns[#conns + 1] = Runtime:TrackConnection(targetPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.defer(function()
            if Runtime.Alive and Config.ESP and character and character.Parent then createESP(character, targetPlayer) end
        end)
    end))
    conns[#conns + 1] = Runtime:TrackConnection(targetPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
        removeESPForTarget(character)
    end))
    if targetPlayer.Character and Config.ESP then createESP(targetPlayer.Character, targetPlayer) end
end
Runtime:TrackConnection(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(targetPlayer)
    bindESPPlayer(targetPlayer)
end))
table.insert(Runtime.PlayerLeave, function(targetPlayer)
    Runtime.S.ESPPlayerData[targetPlayer] = nil
    local conns = Runtime.S.ESPPlayerConns[targetPlayer]
    if conns then
        for _, connection in ipairs(conns) do
            Runtime:UntrackConnection(connection)
            pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
        end
        Runtime.S.ESPPlayerConns[targetPlayer] = nil
    end
    if targetPlayer.Character then removeESPForTarget(targetPlayer.Character) end
end)
for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bindESPPlayer(targetPlayer) end
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(1) do
        if Config.ESP then pcall(syncESP) end
    end
end)
local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
Runtime.PortalESP = { Objects = {}, VSites = {} }
local PORTAL_COLORS = {
    ["Portal C"] = { 255, 170, 0 },
    ["Portal V"] = { 0, 210, 255 },
    ["Portal"] = { 255, 170, 0 },
}
local function makePortalBillboard(adornee, sizeY, offset, col)
    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = "SamiHubPortalESP"
    bb.Adornee = adornee
    bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, Config.ESPSizeX, 0, sizeY)
    bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, offset, 0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.Parent = adornee
    Runtime:TrackInstance(bb)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = Config.ESPTextSize
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    lbl.RichText = true
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.Parent = bb
    local es = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    es.Color = Color3.fromRGB(col[1], col[2], col[3])
    es.Thickness = Config.ESPStrokeThickness
    es.Transparency = Config.ESPStrokeUITransparency
    es.Parent = lbl
    return bb, lbl
end
local function portalAdornee(root)
    if root:IsA("BasePart") then return root end
    return root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
local function portalKind(root)
    local name = root.Name
    if name:find("VPortal", 1, true) then return "Portal V" end
    if name:find("PortalTemplateC", 1, true) then return "Portal C" end
    if typeof(root:GetAttribute("FocusPosition")) == "Vector3" then return "Portal C" end
    return "Portal"
end
local function looksLikePortal(child)
    if typeof(child:GetAttribute("FocusPosition")) == "Vector3" then return true end
    if CS:HasTag(child, "NearbyLoDFocus") then return true end
    local n = child.Name
    if n == "PortalTemplateC" or n == "VPortal" then return true end
    if n == "Portal" then
        local ad = portalAdornee(child)
        if not ad then return false end
        local pos = ad.Position
        for _, other in pairs(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) do
            if other.kind == "Portal V" and other.adornee and other.adornee.Parent
                and (other.adornee.Position - pos).Magnitude <= 20 then
                return true
            end
        end
        for _, site in ipairs(Runtime.PortalESP.VSites) do
            if (site.pos - pos).Magnitude <= 20 then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function removePortalESP(root)
    local data = Runtime.PortalESP.Objects[root]
    if not data then return end
    if data.billboard then Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.billboard) pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
    if data.destPart then
        Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.destPart)
        if data.destBillboard then Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.destBillboard) end
        pcall(function() data.destPart:Destroy() end)
    end
    if data.kind == "Portal V" and data.adornee then
        local sites = Runtime.PortalESP.VSites
        sites[#sites + 1] = { pos = data.adornee.Position, expiry = os.clock() + 10 }
    end
    Runtime.PortalESP.Objects[root] = nil
end
local function clearPortalESP()
    for root in pairs(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) do removePortalESP(root) end
end
local function portalNear(pos)
    for _, other in pairs(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) do
        if other.adornee and other.adornee.Parent
            and (other.adornee.Position - pos).Magnitude <= 12 then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function addPortalESP(root)
    if not Runtime.Alive then return end
    if not (Config.PortalESP or Config.TweenToPortal) then return end
    if Runtime.PortalESP.Objects[root] then return end
    local adornee = portalAdornee(root)
    if not adornee then return end
    local kind = portalKind(root)
    local col = PORTAL_COLORS[kind] or PORTAL_COLORS["Portal"]
    local bb, lbl = makePortalBillboard(adornee, Config.ESPTextSize + 14, Config.ESPStudsOffset + 4, col)
    local data = { billboard = bb, label = lbl, adornee = adornee, kind = kind, lastText = "", destLastText = "", r = col[1], g = col[2], b = col[3] }
    local dest = root:GetAttribute("FocusPosition")
    if typeof(dest) == "Vector3" and not portalNear(dest) then
        local marker = Instance.new("Part")
        marker.Name = "SamiHubPortalDest"
        marker.Size = Vector3.one
        marker.Transparency = 1
        marker.Anchored = true
        marker.CanCollide = false
        marker.CanQuery = false
        marker.CanTouch = false
        marker.CFrame = CFrame.new(dest)
        marker.Parent = WS
        Runtime:TrackInstance(marker)
        local dbb, dlbl = makePortalBillboard(marker, Config.ESPTextSize + 14, Config.ESPStudsOffset + 2, col)
        data.destPart = marker
        data.destBillboard = dbb
        data.destLabel = dlbl
    end
    Runtime.PortalESP.Objects[root] = data
end
task.spawn(function()
    local wo = WS:WaitForChild("_WorldOrigin", 15)
    if not wo then return end
    Runtime:TrackConnection(wo.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if (Config.PortalESP or Config.TweenToPortal) and looksLikePortal(child) then
            task.defer(addPortalESP, child)
        end
    end))
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(Config.PortalESPUpdateInterval) do
        pcall(function()
        if not (Config.PortalESP or Config.TweenToPortal) then
            if next(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) then clearPortalESP() end
            return
        end
        for root in pairs(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) do
            if not root.Parent then removePortalESP(root) end
        end
        local wo = getWorldFolder("_WorldOrigin")
        if wo then
            for _, child in ipairs(wo:GetChildren()) do
                if not Runtime.PortalESP.Objects[child] and looksLikePortal(child) then
                    addPortalESP(child)
                end
            end
        end
        local sites = Runtime.PortalESP.VSites
        for i = #sites, 1, -1 do
            if sites[i].expiry < os.clock() then table.remove(sites, i) end
        end
        local mH = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        for root, data in pairs(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) do
            if not data.adornee.Parent then
                local ad = portalAdornee(root)
                if ad then
                    data.adornee = ad
                    data.billboard.Adornee = ad
                    data.billboard.Parent = ad
                end
            end
            if data.kind == "Portal" then
                local pos = data.adornee.Position
                local nearV = false
                for _, other in pairs(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) do
                    if other ~= data and other.kind == "Portal V" and other.adornee.Parent
                        and (other.adornee.Position - pos).Magnitude <= 20 then
                        nearV = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not nearV then
                    for _, site in ipairs(sites) do
                        if (site.pos - pos).Magnitude <= 20 then nearV = true break end
                    end
                end
                if nearV then data.kind = "Portal V" end
            end
            if data.destPart and portalNear(data.destPart.Position) then
                Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.destPart)
                if data.destBillboard then Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.destBillboard) end
                pcall(function() data.destPart:Destroy() end)
                data.destPart, data.destBillboard, data.destLabel = nil, nil, nil
            end
            if mH and data.adornee.Parent then
                local dist = math.floor((mH.Position - data.adornee.Position).Magnitude)
                local visible = Config.PortalESP and dist <= Config.PortalESPMaxDistance
                data.billboard.Enabled = visible
                if data.destBillboard then data.destBillboard.Enabled = visible end
                if visible then
                    local text = string.format("<font color='rgb(%d,%d,%d)'>%s</font>  <font color='rgb(120,120,120)'>%dm</font>",
                        data.r, data.g, data.b, data.kind, dist)
                    if text ~= data.lastText then data.label.Text = text data.lastText = text end
                    if data.destLabel then
                        local dText = string.format("<font color='rgb(%d,%d,%d)'>%s Exit</font>",
                            data.r, data.g, data.b, data.kind)
                        if dText ~= data.destLastText then data.destLabel.Text = dText data.destLastText = dText end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        end)
    end
end)
local function getST() return WS.GetServerTimeNow and WS:GetServerTimeNow() or os.clock() end
local function discFlag()
    for _, f in ipairs({RepStorage:FindFirstChild("Util"), RepStorage:FindFirstChild("Common"), RepStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes"), RepStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets"), RepStorage:FindFirstChild("FX")}) do
        if f then
            for _, c in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") and c:GetAttribute("Id") then
                    Runtime.S.FlagId, Runtime.S.FlagRemote = c:GetAttribute("Id"), c
                end
            end
            Runtime:TrackConnection(f.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") and child:GetAttribute("Id") then
                    Runtime.S.FlagId, Runtime.S.FlagRemote = child:GetAttribute("Id"), child
                end
            end))
        end
    end
end
discFlag()
local function doFlagAtk()
    if not RegisterHit then return end
    local c, hrp, t = player.Character, player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not c or not hrp or not t then return end
    local wt_attr = t:GetAttribute("WeaponType")
    if wt_attr ~= "Melee" and wt_attr ~= "Sword" then return end
    table.clear(Runtime.S.FlagTargets)
    local targets = Runtime.S.FlagTargets
    for _, folder in ipairs({WS:FindFirstChild("Enemies"), WS:FindFirstChild("Characters")}) do
        if folder then
            for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                local vH, vU = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if v ~= c and vH and vU and vU.Health > 0 and (vH.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= Config.FlagM1Range then
                    for _, part in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") and (vH.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= Config.FlagM1Range then
                            table.insert(targets, {v, part})
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #targets > 0 then
        table.sort(targets, function(a, b)
            local aH, bH = a[1]:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), b[1]:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if aH and bH then
                return (aH.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude < (bH.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            end
            return aH and true or false
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if NetModule then NetModule:RemoteEvent("RegisterHit", true) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if RegisterAttack then RegisterAttack:FireServer() end
            local h = targets[1][1]:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if h then
                local tid = tostring(player.UserId):sub(2,4) .. tostring(coroutine.running()):sub(11,15)
                RegisterHit:FireServer(h, targets, {}, tid)
                if Runtime.S.FlagRemote then
                    local seedRemote = Net:FindFirstChild("seed")
                    local sVal = 0
                    if seedRemote then pcall(function() sVal = seedRemote:InvokeServer() end) end
                    local fRem = (cloneref and cloneref(Runtime.S.FlagRemote)) or RepStorage:FindFirstChild(Runtime.S.FlagRemote.Name) or Runtime.S.FlagRemote
                    fRem:FireServer(string.gsub("RE/RegisterHit", ".", function(ch)
                        return string.char(xor(string.byte(ch), math.floor(getST() / 10 % 10) + 1))
                    end), xor(Runtime.S.FlagId + FLAG_XOR_BASE, sVal * FLAG_SEED_MUL), h, targets)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end
Features.Flag = makeLooper(
    0.005,
    function() return Config.FlaggedM1 and Config.IsRunning end,
    function() pcall(doFlagAtk) end
)
local function getFruit()
    local c, bp = player.Character, player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if bp then for _, v in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do if v:GetAttribute("WeaponType") == "Demon Fruit" then return v end end end
    if c then for _, v in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do if v:GetAttribute("WeaponType") == "Demon Fruit" then return v end end end
end
Features.Fruit = makeLooper(
    0.05,
    function() return Config.FruitM1 and Config.IsRunning end,
    function()
        if os.clock() - Runtime.S.LFF2 < Config.FruitM1Cooldown then return end
        Runtime.S.LFF2 = os.clock()
        local c = player.Character
        if not c or not c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        local f = getFruit()
        if not f then return end
        local r = f:FindFirstChild("LeftClickRemote")
        if not r then return end
        local myH = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myH then return end
        local target = getNearest()
        local dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        if target then
            local tH = target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if tH then
                dir = (tH.Position - myH.Position).Unit
            end
        end
        for i = 1, 5 do
            if not Features.Fruit.Active() then break end
            pcall(function() r:FireServer(dir, i, true) end)
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
    end,
    nil,
    true
)
local SPECIAL_MAX_VEC = Vector3.new(9e30, 9e30, 9e30)
local function safeSpecialFire(r)
    if not r then return end
    r:FireServer(SPECIAL_MAX_VEC, 5, false)
end
Features.SpecialFruit = makeLooper(
    nil,
    function() return Config.SpecialFruitAura and Config.IsRunning end,
    function()
        if os.clock() - Runtime.S.LSF2 < Config.SpecialFruitCooldown then return end
        Runtime.S.LSF2 = os.clock()
        local c = player.Character
        if not c or not c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        local f = getFruit()
        if not f then return end
        local r = f:FindFirstChild("LeftClickRemote")
        if not r then return end
        safeSpecialFire(r)
    end,
    nil,
    true
)
Runtime.S.TwRunning = false
local function updatePredictionHistory(tH)
    local tN = tH.Parent.Name
    if Runtime.S.LastInstaTargetName ~= tN then
        if Runtime.S.LastInstaTargetName then Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory[Runtime.S.LastInstaTargetName] = nil end
        Runtime.S.LastInstaTargetName = tN
    end
    if not Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory[tN] then
        Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory[tN] = { positions = {}, timestamps = {}, head = 1, count = 0, capacity = Config.PredictionSamples, lastUpdate = 0, lastPos = nil }
    end
    local h = Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory[tN]
    local ct, cp = os.clock(), tH.Position
    local maxSamples = Config.PredictionSamples
    if h.capacity ~= maxSamples then
        local oldCount = h.count or #h.positions
        local oldHead = h.head or 1
        local oldCapacity = h.capacity or oldCount
        local keepFrom = math.max(1, oldCount - maxSamples + 1)
        local positions, timestamps, newCount = {}, {}, 0
        for logicalIndex = keepFrom, oldCount do
            newCount = newCount + 1
            local oldIndex = h.head and (((oldHead + logicalIndex - 2) % oldCapacity) + 1) or logicalIndex
            positions[newCount] = h.positions[oldIndex]
            timestamps[newCount] = h.timestamps[oldIndex]
        end
        h.positions, h.timestamps = positions, timestamps
        h.head, h.count, h.capacity = 1, newCount, maxSamples
    end
    if h.lastPos and (cp - h.lastPos).Magnitude > Config.InstaMaxJump then
        h.positions = {cp}
        h.timestamps = {ct}
        h.head, h.count, h.capacity = 1, 1, maxSamples
        h.lastPos = cp
        h.lastUpdate = ct
    elseif ct - h.lastUpdate >= Config.PredictionSampleInterval then
        local writeIndex
        if h.count < maxSamples then
            writeIndex = ((h.head + h.count - 1) % maxSamples) + 1
            h.count = h.count + 1
        else
            writeIndex = h.head
            h.head = (h.head % maxSamples) + 1
        end
        h.positions[writeIndex] = cp
        h.timestamps[writeIndex] = ct
        h.lastUpdate = ct
        h.lastPos = cp
    end
end
Runtime.S.TwGen = 0
local function enterPhys(hum)
    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
end
local function restoreHum(hum)
    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
end
do
    Runtime.S.APNoclip = {}
    Runtime.S.APState = false
    Runtime.S.APNextSweep = 0
    Runtime.S.APPhys = false
    Runtime.S.APSetNoclip = function(char, on)
        if not char then return end
        if on then
            if Runtime.S.APState then
                if os.clock() < (Runtime.S.APNextSweep or 0) then return end
            end
            Runtime.S.APState = true
            Runtime.S.APNextSweep = os.clock() + 0.15
            for _, v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("BasePart") and Runtime.S.APNoclip[v] == nil then
                    Runtime.S.APNoclip[v] = v.CanCollide
                    Runtime:Override(v, "CanCollide", false)
                end
            end
        else
            if not Runtime.S.APState then return end
            Runtime.S.APState = false
            for part, orig in pairs(Runtime.S.APNoclip) do
                if part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = orig end) end
            end
            Runtime.S.APNoclip = {}
        end
    end
    Runtime:TrackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        Runtime.S.APNoclip = {}
        Runtime.S.APState = false
        Runtime.S.APPhys = false
    end))
end
local function stopTwn()
    Runtime.S.TwGen = Runtime.S.TwGen + 1
    Runtime.S.TwRunning = false
    Runtime.S.InstaActive = false
    Runtime.S.CurrentTwMode = nil
    if Runtime.S.ActiveTween then Runtime.S.ActiveTween:Cancel() Runtime.S.ActiveTween = nil end
    if Runtime.S.TweenPlatform then
        Runtime:UntrackInstance(Runtime.S.TweenPlatform)
        Runtime.S.TweenPlatform:Destroy()
        Runtime.S.TweenPlatform = nil
    end
    Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory, Runtime.S.LastInstaTargetName = {}, nil
    Runtime.S.CurrentTargetPlayer = nil
    Runtime.S.TwLastPos, Runtime.S.TwLastAt = nil, 0
    if Runtime.S.APSetNoclip then
        local char = player.Character
        if char then pcall(Runtime.S.APSetNoclip, char, false) end
    end
    if Runtime.S.APPhys then
        Runtime.S.APPhys = false
        local char = player.Character
        local mU = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if mU then pcall(restoreHum, mU) end
    end
end
local function zeroVelocity(part)
    part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
local function setVelocity(part, vel)
    part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
end
local function syncTweenVelocity(mH)
    local now = os.clock()
    local lastPos, lastAt = Runtime.S.TwLastPos, Runtime.S.TwLastAt or 0
    Runtime.S.TwLastPos, Runtime.S.TwLastAt = mH.Position, now
    if not lastPos then return end
    local dt = now - lastAt
    if dt <= 0.01 then return end
    local vel = (mH.Position - lastPos) / dt
    local mag = vel.Magnitude
    if mag < 0.5 then
        pcall(zeroVelocity, mH)
        return
    end
    local capSpeed = Config.TweenSpeed
    if Runtime.S.FlyBusy then capSpeed = Config.FlyBusySpeed end
    local cap = (capSpeed or 200) * 1.5
    if mag > cap then vel = vel * (cap / mag) end
    pcall(setVelocity, mH, vel)
end
local function syncTweenPlatform(mH)
    if Runtime.S.TweenPlatform and mH then
        Runtime.S.TweenPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(mH.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
    end
end
local function applySnapCFrame(mH, tH, orbit, yOff, xOff, zOff)
    local pp = getPredictedPos(tH, Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory[tH.Parent.Name] or {positions={}}, Config.NoPredict)
    if not pp then pp = tH.Position end
    local focus = pp
    if orbit then
        pp = pp + Vector3.new(math.cos(os.clock() * Config.CircleOrbitSpeed) * Config.CircleRadius, 0, math.sin(os.clock() * Config.CircleOrbitSpeed) * Config.CircleRadius)
    end
    local place = pp + Vector3.new((xOff or 0), yOff, (zOff or 0))
    if Config.SkillRedirectTweenAim then
        local look = focus - place
        if look.Magnitude > 0.5 then
            if math.abs(look.X) + math.abs(look.Z) < 0.02 * math.max(look.Magnitude, 1) then
                focus = focus + Vector3.new(0.02, 0, 0.02)
            end
            mH.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(place, focus)
            return
        end
    end
    mH.CFrame = CFrame.new(place)
end
pauseTwn = function(seconds)
    if not Runtime.S.TwRunning then return end
    Runtime.S.TwPausedUntil = os.clock() + (seconds or 0.5)
    if Runtime.S.ActiveTween then Runtime.S.ActiveTween:Cancel() Runtime.S.ActiveTween = nil end
    local char = player.Character
    local mH = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if mH then
        pcall(zeroVelocity, mH)
    end
end
local TweenToggles = {}
local function syncTweenToggle(key, value)
    local toggle = TweenToggles[key]
    if toggle then
        pcall(function() toggle:SetValue(value) end)
    end
end
local function startTwn()
    stopTwn()
    Runtime.S.TwGen = Runtime.S.TwGen + 1
    Runtime.S.TwRunning = true
    local myGen = Runtime.S.TwGen
    Runtime.S.TweenPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
    Runtime.S.TweenPlatform.Name = "TweenPlatform"
    Runtime.S.TweenPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
    Runtime.S.TweenPlatform.Transparency = 1
    Runtime.S.TweenPlatform.Anchored = true
    Runtime.S.TweenPlatform.CanCollide = true
    Runtime.S.TweenPlatform.Parent = WS
    Runtime:TrackInstance(Runtime.S.TweenPlatform)
    task.spawn(function()
        while Runtime.Alive and task.wait() and Runtime.S.TwRunning and Runtime.S.TwGen == myGen do
            if not (Config.TweenToPlayer or Config.TweenToNearest or Config.TweenToPortal) then stopTwn() continue end
            local character = player.Character
            local mH = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not mH then continue end
            local mU = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            Runtime.S.InstaActive = false
            pcall(syncTweenVelocity, mH)
            if os.clock() < Runtime.S.TwPausedUntil then
                pcall(Runtime.S.APSetNoclip, character, false)
                pcall(syncTweenPlatform, mH)
                continue
            end
            local mode = nil
            if Config.TweenToPortal then mode = 'portal'
            elseif Config.TweenToPlayer then mode = 'player'
            elseif Config.TweenToNearest then mode = 'nearest' end
            if mode ~= Runtime.S.CurrentTwMode then
                Runtime.S.CurrentTwMode = mode
                if Runtime.S.ActiveTween then Runtime.S.ActiveTween:Cancel() Runtime.S.ActiveTween = nil end
            end
            if not mode then continue end
            local tH, tP = nil, nil
            local yOff, orbit = Config.YOffset, Config.CircleTarget
            local xOff, zOff = Config.TeleportOffsetX or 0, Config.TeleportOffsetZ or 0
            if mode == 'portal' then
                yOff, orbit, xOff, zOff = 0, false, 0, 0
                local nD = math.huge
                for _, pdata in pairs(Runtime.PortalESP.Objects) do
                    if pdata.adornee and pdata.adornee.Parent then
                        local d = (pdata.adornee.Position - mH.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < nD and d <= Config.TweenMaxRange then nD, tH = d, pdata.adornee end
                    end
                end
            elseif mode == 'player' then
                local t = getSelectedPlayer()
                if t and t.Character then tH, tP = t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), t end
            else
                local n, nD = nil, math.huge
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= player and not CachedAllies[p] and isValid(p) and p.Character then
                        local h, u = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                        if h and u and u.Health > 0 then local d = (h.Position - mH.Position).Magnitude if d < nD and d <= Config.TweenMaxRange then nD, n, tP = d, h, p end end
                    end
                end
                tH = n
            end
            if not tH or not tH.Parent then
                pcall(Runtime.S.APSetNoclip, character, false)
                continue
            end
            Runtime.S.CurrentTargetPlayer = tP
            local dist = (mH.Position - tH.Position).Magnitude
            updatePredictionHistory(tH)
            if dist <= Config.InstaSnapDistance and Config.MovementMode ~= "Pure Tween" then
                if Runtime.S.ActiveTween then Runtime.S.ActiveTween:Cancel() Runtime.S.ActiveTween = nil end
                Runtime.S.InstaActive = true
                if Config.AntiPullback then
                    pcall(Runtime.S.APSetNoclip, character, true)
                    if mU then
                        pcall(enterPhys, mU)
                        Runtime.S.APPhys = true
                    end
                end
                pcall(applySnapCFrame, mH, tH, orbit, yOff, xOff, zOff)
            else
                Runtime.S.InstaActive = false
                -- Prediction now feeds the tween target as well, matching what
                -- the insta-snap path already does (applySnapCFrame predicts).
                -- NoPredict still disables it, and getPredictedPos falls back to
                -- the raw position until the history holds >= 2 samples.
                local basePos = getPredictedPos(tH, Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory[tH.Parent.Name], Config.NoPredict) or tH.Position
                local focusPos = basePos
                local tPos = basePos + Vector3.new(xOff, yOff, zOff)
                if orbit then
                    tPos = tPos + Vector3.new(math.cos(os.clock()*Config.CircleOrbitSpeed)*Config.CircleRadius, 0, math.sin(os.clock()*Config.CircleOrbitSpeed)*Config.CircleRadius)
                end
                local arrived = Runtime.S.ActiveTween ~= nil
                    and Runtime.S.ActiveTween.PlaybackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
                    and (tPos - mH.Position).Magnitude < 3
                local needsNewTween
                if Config.AntiPullback then
                    needsNewTween = not arrived
                else
                    needsNewTween = not Runtime.S.ActiveTween
                        or Runtime.S.ActiveTween.PlaybackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
                        or (Runtime.S.LastTargetPos - tPos).Magnitude > Config.TweenRecalcThreshold
                end
                if needsNewTween then
                    if Runtime.S.ActiveTween then Runtime.S.ActiveTween:Cancel() end
                    if not Config.AntiPullback then
                        mH.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
                    else
                        mH.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        pcall(Runtime.S.APSetNoclip, character, true)
                        if mU then
                            pcall(enterPhys, mU)
                            Runtime.S.APPhys = true
                        end
                    end
                    local goalCF = CFrame.new(tPos)
                    if Config.SkillRedirectTweenAim then
                        local look = focusPos - tPos
                        if look.Magnitude > 0.5 then
                            local focus = focusPos
                            if math.abs(look.X) + math.abs(look.Z) < 0.02 * math.max(look.Magnitude, 1) then
                                focus = focus + Vector3.new(0.02, 0, 0.02)
                            end
                            goalCF = CFrame.lookAt(tPos, focus)
                        end
                    end
                    local tweenSpeed = Config.TweenSpeed
                    if Runtime.S.FlyBusy then tweenSpeed = Config.FlyBusySpeed end
                    -- Pure Tween mode never insta-snaps, so inside the snap
                    -- distance use the faster tween speed instead of a CFrame
                    -- set. FlyBusy wins: the busy-state speed you chose for
                    -- that state is never overridden here.
                    if Config.MovementMode == "Pure Tween" and not Runtime.S.FlyBusy
                        and dist <= Config.InstaSnapDistance then
                        tweenSpeed = Config.PureTweenFastSpeed
                    end
                    local tweenDuration
                    if Config.AntiPullback then
                        tweenDuration = (tPos - mH.Position).Magnitude / tweenSpeed
                    else
                        tweenDuration = math.max(dist / tweenSpeed, Config.TweenMinDuration)
                    end
                    Runtime.S.ActiveTween = TS:Create(mH,
                        TweenInfo.new(tweenDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                        {CFrame = goalCF})
                    Runtime.S.ActiveTween:Play()
                    Runtime.S.LastTargetPos = tPos
                end
                if Config.AntiPullback and not needsNewTween
                    and (not Runtime.S.ActiveTween or Runtime.S.ActiveTween.PlaybackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Playing) then
                    pcall(Runtime.S.APSetNoclip, character, false)
                end
            end
            pcall(syncTweenPlatform, mH)
        end
    end)
end
local function lockTarget()
    if not Config.TweenToPlayer then
        local closest, shortest = nil, math.huge
        local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
        local mPos = IsMobile
            and Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
            or UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= player and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and p.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 and not CachedAllies[p] then
                local tP = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(tP.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local dist = (Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y, 0) - Vector3.new(mPos.X, mPos.Y, 0)).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortest then shortest, closest = dist, p end
                end
            end
        end
        if closest then
            SelectedPlayer = closest.Name
            if Config.TweenToNearest then
                Config.TweenToNearest = false
                syncTweenToggle('Nearest', false)
            end
            Config.TweenToPlayer = true
            syncTweenToggle('Player', true)
            startTwn()
        end
    else
        Config.TweenToPlayer = false
        syncTweenToggle('Player', false)
        if not (Config.TweenToNearest or Config.TweenToPortal) then stopTwn() end
    end
end
do
-- =========================================================================
-- Silent Aim (ported from the little file — uses Config.SilentAim* vars)
-- =========================================================================
Runtime.SilentAim = { Circle = nil, Line = nil }
local LastSkillPressed = 'Z'
local currentSilentAimTarget = nil

local function IsSkillSelected(skillName)
    local skills = Config.SilentAimSkills
    if not skills then return true end
    if type(skills) == 'table' then
        if next(skills) == nil then return false end
        if skills[skillName] ~= nil then
            return skills[skillName] == true
        end
        for _, v in pairs(skills) do
            if v == skillName then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    return true
end
local function IsCurrentSkillEnabled()
    return IsSkillSelected(LastSkillPressed)
end
local function SA_IsAlive(character)
    if not character then return false end
    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
end
local function SA_IsAlly(other)
    local main = player:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui') and player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('Main')
    local frame = main and main:FindFirstChild('Allies')
        and main.Allies:FindFirstChild('Container')
        and main.Allies.Container:FindFirstChild('Allies')
        and main.Allies.Container.Allies:FindFirstChild('ScrollingFrame')
        and main.Allies.Container.Allies.ScrollingFrame:FindFirstChild('Frame')
    if not frame then return false end
    return frame:FindFirstChild(other.Name) ~= nil
end
local function SA_IsEnemy(other)
    if not other or other == player then return false end
    if SA_IsAlly(other) then return false end
    local myTeam, targetTeam = player.Team, other.Team
    if myTeam and targetTeam and myTeam.Name == 'Marines' and targetTeam.Name == 'Marines' then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
local function SA_GetOrigin()
    local p = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
    if Config.SilentAimFOVMode == 'Screen Center' or p.X <= 0 or p.Y <= 0 then
        local v = WS.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        return Vector2.new(v.X / 2, v.Y / 2)
    end
    return p
end
local function SA_GetClosestTarget()
    local method = Config.SilentAimMethod or 'Closest to Mouse'
    local partName = Config.SilentAimPart
    if method == 'Selected Player' then
        if not Config.SilentAimTargetPlayers then return nil end
        local name = Config.SilentAimSelectedPlayer
        if not name or name == '' then return nil end
        local target = Players:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not target or target == player then return nil end
        if Config.SilentAimTeamCheck and not SA_IsEnemy(target) then return nil end
        if Config.SilentAimExcludePVP and target:GetAttribute('PvpDisabled') == true then return nil end
        local character = target.Character
        if not SA_IsAlive(character) then return nil end
        return character:FindFirstChild(partName) or character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    end
    if method == 'Closest Player' then
        local myChar = player.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not myRoot then return nil end
        local closest, shortest = nil, math.huge
        local myPos = myRoot.Position
        local function checkNearest(character)
            if not SA_IsAlive(character) then return end
            local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName) or character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if not part then return end
            local d = (part.Position - myPos).Magnitude
            if d < shortest then closest, shortest = part, d end
        end
        if Config.SilentAimTargetPlayers then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= player then
                    if (not Config.SilentAimTeamCheck or SA_IsEnemy(p)) and not (Config.SilentAimExcludePVP and p:GetAttribute('PvpDisabled') == true) then
                        checkNearest(p.Character)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if Config.SilentAimTargetMobs and WS:FindFirstChild('Enemies') then
            for _, enemy in ipairs(WS.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
                checkNearest(enemy)
            end
        end
        return closest
    end
    -- Closest to Mouse (default)
    local origin = SA_GetOrigin()
    local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
    local closest, shortest = nil, math.huge
    local fov = Config.SilentAimFOV
    local function check(character)
        if not SA_IsAlive(character) then return end
        local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName) or character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not part then return end
        local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if onScreen then
            local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - origin).Magnitude
            if dist <= fov and dist < shortest then closest, shortest = part, dist end
        end
    end
    if Config.SilentAimTargetPlayers then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= player then
                if (not Config.SilentAimTeamCheck or SA_IsEnemy(p)) and not (Config.SilentAimExcludePVP and p:GetAttribute('PvpDisabled') == true) then
                    check(p.Character)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if Config.SilentAimTargetMobs and WS:FindFirstChild('Enemies') then
        for _, enemy in ipairs(WS.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
            check(enemy)
        end
    end
    return closest
end
-- FOV circle + lock line
pcall(function()
    local circle = Drawing.new('Circle')
    circle.Visible = false
    circle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    circle.Radius = Config.SilentAimFOV or 150
    circle.Thickness = 2
    circle.Filled = false
    Runtime.SilentAim.Circle = circle
    if Config.SilentAimShowFOV then circle.Visible = true end
    if Config.SilentAimFOV then circle.Radius = Config.SilentAimFOV end
end)
pcall(function()
    local lockLine = Drawing.new('Line')
    lockLine.Thickness = 2
    lockLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    lockLine.Transparency = 1
    lockLine.Visible = false
    Runtime.SilentAim.Line = lockLine
end)
-- FOV circle position follower
if Runtime.SilentAim.Circle then
    Runtime:TrackConnection(RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local c = Runtime.SilentAim.Circle
        if not c or not c.Visible then return end
        c.Position = SA_GetOrigin()
    end))
end
-- Namecall hook: rewrite only the FIRST Vector3 arg in FireServer/InvokeServer,
-- and ONLY within a 1.5s window after a skill keypress. Without the time window,
-- the hook fires on every remote call (effects, animations, etc.) and breaks
-- move visuals. The 1.5s window matches the big file's original SkillRedirect
-- design — it means only skill-fired remotes get redirected, everything else
-- passes through untouched so moves stay visible.
if not HubEnv.__SamiHubSilentAimNamecall then
    pcall(function()
        local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
        local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
        setreadonly(mt, false)
        mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
            local method = getnamecallmethod()
            if Config.SilentAimSkill and IsCurrentSkillEnabled() and currentSilentAimTarget
                and (method == 'FireServer' or method == 'InvokeServer') then
                -- Time window: only redirect within 1.5s of a skill keypress.
                -- This stops the hook from rewriting effect/animation remotes
                -- that fire AFTER the skill, which was making moves invisible.
                local pressed = Runtime.S and Runtime.S.SkillKeyTime
                if not pressed or (os.clock() - pressed) > 1.5 then
                    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                end
                local sName = tostring(self)
                if sName == 'RemoteEvent' or sName == 'CommE' or sName == 'RemoteFunction' then
                    local args = {...}
                    local nargs = select('#', ...)
                    -- Find and rewrite ONLY the first Vector3 arg (the target position).
                    for i = 2, nargs do
                        if typeof(args[i]) == 'Vector3' then
                            args[i] = currentSilentAimTarget.Position
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    -- Face the target as the skill fires (yaw only, so the
                    -- character stays upright and the move renders correctly).
                    local char = player.Character
                    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    if root then
                        local cp = root.Position
                        local tp = currentSilentAimTarget.Position
                        local flat = Vector3.new(tp.X - cp.X, 0, tp.Z - cp.Z)
                        if flat.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                            root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cp, cp + flat.Unit, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
                        end
                    end
                    return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args, 1, nargs))
                end
            end
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end)
        setreadonly(mt, true)
        HubEnv.__SamiHubSilentAimNamecall = true
    end)
end
-- Mouse module hook: redirect Hit/Target when skill silent aim is active.
if not HubEnv.__SamiHubSilentAimMouseModule then
    pcall(function()
        local mouseModuleInst = RepStorage:FindFirstChild('Mouse')
        local mm = mouseModuleInst and require(mouseModuleInst) or nil
        if mm and typeof(mm) == 'table' then
            local realStore = { Hit = rawget(mm, 'Hit'), Target = rawget(mm, 'Target') }
            local mmt = getrawmetatable(mm)
            if mmt then setreadonly(mmt, false) else mmt = {}; setmetatable(mm, mmt) end
            rawset(mm, 'Hit', nil); rawset(mm, 'Target', nil)
            mmt.__index = function(self, key)
                if key == 'Hit' then
                    if Config.SilentAimSkill and IsCurrentSkillEnabled() and currentSilentAimTarget then
                        return CFrame.new(currentSilentAimTarget.Position)
                    end
                    return realStore.Hit
                elseif key == 'Target' then
                    if Config.SilentAimSkill and IsCurrentSkillEnabled() and currentSilentAimTarget then
                        return currentSilentAimTarget
                    end
                    return realStore.Target
                end
            end
            mmt.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
                if key == 'Hit' or key == 'Target' then realStore[key] = value
                else rawset(self, key, value) end
            end
            setreadonly(mmt, true)
            HubEnv.__SamiHubSilentAimMouseModule = true
        end
    end)
end
-- Mouse __index hook: redirect Hit/Target/UnitRay/Origin/Direction for M1.
if not HubEnv.__SamiHubSilentAimMouseIndex then
    pcall(function()
        local mouse = player:GetMouse()
        local cc = checkcaller
        local oldIndex
        oldIndex = hookmetamethod(game, '__index', function(self, key)
            if Config.SilentAimM1R and IsCurrentSkillEnabled() and currentSilentAimTarget
                and not (cc and cc()) and self == mouse then
                local tp = currentSilentAimTarget.Position
                local cp = WS.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
                if key == 'Hit' then return CFrame.new(tp)
                elseif key == 'Target' then return currentSilentAimTarget
                elseif key == 'UnitRay' then return Ray.new(cp, (tp - cp).Unit)
                elseif key == 'Origin' then return cp
                elseif key == 'Direction' then return (tp - cp).Unit
                end
            end
            return oldIndex(self, key)
        end)
        HubEnv.__SamiHubSilentAimMouseIndex = true
    end)
end
-- RenderStepped: scan for target + update lock line
Runtime:TrackConnection(RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if Config.SilentAimM1R or Config.SilentAimSkill then
        currentSilentAimTarget = SA_GetClosestTarget()
    else
        currentSilentAimTarget = nil
    end
    local line = Runtime.SilentAim.Line
    if line then
        if Config.SilentAimShowLine and currentSilentAimTarget then
            local pos, onScreen = WS.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(currentSilentAimTarget.Position)
            if onScreen then
                line.Visible = true
                line.From = SA_GetOrigin()
                line.To = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
            else
                line.Visible = false
            end
        else
            line.Visible = false
        end
    end
end))
end


local BountyHopActive = false
local BountyHopGen = 0
local ScanGeneration = 0
local BountySelectedRegions = { Germany = true, Netherlands = true, ["United States"] = false, Brazil = false, Singapore = false, Poland = false }
local BountyRegionList = {"Germany", "Netherlands", "United States", "Brazil", "Singapore", "Poland"}
local ScannedServers = {}
local ScannedServerLabels = {}
local function GetSelectedRegions()
    local selected = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(BountyRegionList) do
        if BountySelectedRegions[name] then table.insert(selected, name) end
    end
    return selected
end
local function BH_commas(n)
    n = tostring(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0))
    local sign, digits = n:match("^(%-?)(%d+)$")
    local out = digits:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
    return sign .. out
end
local function BH_shortBounty(n)
    n = tonumber(n) or 0
    if n >= 1e9 then return ("%.1fB"):format(n / 1e9)
    elseif n >= 1e6 then return ("%.1fM"):format(n / 1e6)
    elseif n >= 1e3 then return ("%.1fK"):format(n / 1e3)
    else return tostring(n)
    end
end
local function BH_region_is_preferred(region_str, preferredList)
    region_str = tostring(region_str or ""):lower()
    for _, pref in ipairs(preferredList) do
        if region_str:find(pref:lower(), 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function BH_FetchAllServers(minBounty)
    local ServerBrowserRemote = RepStorage:WaitForChild("__ServerBrowser")
    local results = {}
    local finished = 0
    local MAX_PAGES = Config.BountyMaxPages
    for i = 1, MAX_PAGES do
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, data = pcall(function()
                return ServerBrowserRemote:InvokeServer(i)
            end)
            if ok and type(data) == "table" then
                for job, info in pairs(data) do
                    local bounty = tonumber(info.Bounty) or 0
                    if bounty >= minBounty and job ~= game.JobId then
                        info.Job = job
                        table.insert(results, info)
                    end
                end
            end
            finished = finished + 1
        end)
    end
    local waited = 0
    repeat task.wait(0.1) waited = waited + 0.1 until finished >= MAX_PAGES or waited >= Config.BountyScanTimeout
    table.sort(results, function(a, b)
        return (tonumber(a.Bounty) or 0) > (tonumber(b.Bounty) or 0)
    end)
    return results
end
local function BH_FetchHighBountyServers(preferredRegions)
    local all = BH_FetchAllServers(Config.BountyMinBounty)
    for _, info in ipairs(all) do
        info.Preferred = BH_region_is_preferred(info.Region, preferredRegions)
    end
    table.sort(all, function(a, b)
        if a.Preferred ~= b.Preferred then return a.Preferred end
        return (tonumber(a.Bounty) or 0) > (tonumber(b.Bounty) or 0)
    end)
    return all
end
local function BH_TryJoinServer(jobId)
    local ServerBrowserRemote = RepStorage:WaitForChild("__ServerBrowser")
    pcall(function() ServerBrowserRemote:InvokeServer("teleport", jobId) end)
    task.wait(Config.BountyTeleportRetryWait)
    pcall(function() ServerBrowserRemote:InvokeServer("teleport", jobId) end)
    task.wait(Config.BountyPostTeleportWait)
end
local function RunBountyHop()
    local preferredRegions = GetSelectedRegions()
    if #preferredRegions == 0 then
        warn("[BountyHop] No regions selected!")
        return
    end
    BountyHopGen = BountyHopGen + 1
    BountyHopActive = true
    local myGen = BountyHopGen
    print(("[BountyHop] Scanning for bounty >= %s (regions: %s)"):format(
        BH_commas(Config.BountyMinBounty), table.concat(preferredRegions, ", ")))
