    local servers = BH_FetchHighBountyServers(preferredRegions)
    if BountyHopGen ~= myGen then return end
    print(("[BountyHop] Found %d candidate servers."):format(#servers))
    if #servers == 0 then
        warn("[BountyHop] No servers matched.")
        BountyHopActive = false
        return
    end
    for i, info in ipairs(servers) do
        if i > Config.BountyMaxJoinAttempts then break end
        print(("[BountyHop]   %d. %s | %s | Players: %s | Bounty: %s%s"):format(
            i, tostring(info.Job), tostring(info.Region),
            tostring(info.Count), BH_commas(info.Bounty),
            info.Preferred and "  [preferred]" or ""))
    end
    for i, info in ipairs(servers) do
        if not BountyHopActive or BountyHopGen ~= myGen then break end
        print(("[BountyHop] [%d/%d] Joining %s (%s, bounty %s)%s"):format(
            i, #servers, tostring(info.Job), tostring(info.Region),
            BH_commas(info.Bounty), info.Preferred and "  [preferred]" or ""))
        BH_TryJoinServer(info.Job)
        if not BountyHopActive or BountyHopGen ~= myGen then break end
        warn(("[BountyHop] Still here - %s didn't work, trying next..."):format(tostring(info.Job)))
    end
    if BountyHopActive and BountyHopGen == myGen then
        warn("[BountyHop] Exhausted all candidate servers.")
    end
    BountyHopActive = false
end

-- Conditional inputs: the snap distance only matters in Hybrid mode, the fast
-- tween speed only in Pure Tween. Linoria's DependencyBox decides visibility
-- from the dependency's .Type/.Value, so we hand it small shim tables and flip
-- those from the mode callback. The widgets themselves are never destroyed, so
-- both values keep saving and loading normally across mode switches.
-- Scoped in a do-block on purpose: the DEV build's UI sits at chunk level, so
-- these four locals would otherwise become top-level registers (budget 185).
do
    local ModeShimHybrid = { Type = 'Toggle', Value = (Config.MovementMode ~= 'Pure Tween') }
    local ModeShimPure = { Type = 'Toggle', Value = (Config.MovementMode == 'Pure Tween') }
    PVPSettings:AddDropdown('MovementMode', {
        Text = 'Movement Mode',
        Values = { 'Hybrid (Insta + Tween)', 'Pure Tween' },
        Default = (Config.MovementMode == 'Pure Tween') and 'Pure Tween' or 'Hybrid (Insta + Tween)',
        Multi = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            if type(v) == 'table' then v = v.Title or v.Value end
            Config.MovementMode = (v == 'Pure Tween') and 'Pure Tween' or 'Hybrid'
            ModeShimHybrid.Value = (Config.MovementMode ~= 'Pure Tween')
            ModeShimPure.Value = (Config.MovementMode == 'Pure Tween')
            Library:UpdateDependencyBoxes()
        end,
    })
    local SnapDistanceDep = PVPSettings:AddDependencyBox()
    SnapDistanceDep:SetupDependencies({ { ModeShimHybrid, true } })
    SnapDistanceDep:AddInput('InstaSnapDistance', {
        Text = 'Insta Snap Distance',

    local PureTweenSpeedDep = PVPSettings:AddDependencyBox()
    PureTweenSpeedDep:SetupDependencies({ { ModeShimPure, true } })
    PureTweenSpeedDep:AddInput('PureTweenFastSpeed', {
        Text = 'Fast Tween Speed',

        Finished = false,

end

-- =========================================================================
-- Instant TP & Lock 2 (ported from the little file, adapted to the big
-- file's helpers: getSelectedPlayer, Config.YOffset, Config.TeleportOffsetX/Z,
-- getPredictedPos, stopTwn, pauseTwn).
-- =========================================================================
Runtime.S.InstaTPActive = false
Runtime.S.Lock2Active = false
local InstaTPConnection
local Lock2Connection
local Lock2LastEntrance = 0

-- Get the target HRP for the active movement feature.
-- Honors Config.TweenToNearest (chase nearest) vs selected player.
local function GetInstaTargetHRP(myHRP)
    if Config.TweenToNearest then
        local nearest, nearestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= player and p.Character then
                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local d = (root.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = root, d end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    else
        local target = getSelectedPlayer()
        if not target or not target.Character then return nil end
        return target.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    end
end

-- Lock 2 orbit: instead of teleporting onto the target, TP to a point on a
-- ring around the target (default 125 studs). The ring rotates over time,
-- so you circle the player instead of sitting at one spot.
local function GetLock2OrbitPos(targetPos)
    local r = tonumber(Config.Lock2OrbitDist) or 125
    local angle = (tick() * 1.5) % (math.pi * 2)
    return targetPos + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * r, 0, math.sin(angle) * r)
end

PVPLeft:AddToggle('InstantTP', {
    Text = 'Instant TP',
    Default = Config.InstantTP,
    Tooltip = 'Teleports you onto the selected player (or nearest if Tween To Nearest is on) every frame. Uses X/Y/Z offsets.',
    Callback = function(val)
        Config.InstantTP = val
        if InstaTPConnection then
            InstaTPConnection:Disconnect()
            InstaTPConnection = nil
        end
        if not val then
            Runtime.S.InstaTPActive = false
            return
        end
        -- Require a target unless Tween To Nearest is on
        if not Config.TweenToNearest and not getSelectedPlayer() then
            Config.InstantTP = false
            return
        end
        Runtime.S.InstaTPActive = true
        -- Same engine as the little file's insta TP: runs on every physics step,
        -- snaps UpperTorso to UpperTorso with a relative offset.
        InstaTPConnection = RS.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not Config.InstantTP then
                if InstaTPConnection then
                    InstaTPConnection:Disconnect()
                    InstaTPConnection = nil
                end
                Runtime.S.InstaTPActive = false
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                local character = player.Character
                if not character then return end
                local myRoot = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                if not myRoot then return end
                local myTorso = character:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso') or myRoot
                local tHRP = GetInstaTargetHRP(myRoot)
                if not tHRP then return end
                local targetTorso = tHRP.Parent:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso') or tHRP
                local xOff = Config.TeleportOffsetX or 0
                local yOff = Config.YOffset or 0
                local zOff = Config.TeleportOffsetZ or 0
                myTorso.CFrame = targetTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(xOff, yOff, zOff)
            end)
        end)
    end,
})

PVPLeft:AddToggle('Lock2', {
    Text = 'Lock 2',
    Default = Config.Lock2,
    Tooltip = 'Auto TP approach + orbits the target on a ring (Lock 2 Orbit Distance). Far targets are tweened to; close targets are TP-orbited.',
    Callback = function(val)
        Config.Lock2 = val
        if Lock2Connection then
            Lock2Connection:Disconnect()
            Lock2Connection = nil
        end
        if not val then
            Runtime.S.Lock2Active = false
            if pauseTwn then pcall(pauseTwn, 0.1) end
            return
        end
        -- Require a target unless Tween To Nearest is on
        if not Config.TweenToNearest and not getSelectedPlayer() then
            Config.Lock2 = false
            return
        end
        Runtime.S.Lock2Active = true
        Lock2LastEntrance = 0
        Lock2Connection = RS.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not Config.Lock2 then
                if Lock2Connection then
                    Lock2Connection:Disconnect()
                    Lock2Connection = nil
                end
                Runtime.S.Lock2Active = false
                return
            end
            local myChar = player.Character
            local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if not myHRP then return end
            local tHRP = GetInstaTargetHRP(myHRP)
            if not tHRP then return end
            -- Use the big file's getPredictedPos for velocity-based prediction
            local history = Runtime.S.PlayerPositionHistory[tHRP.Parent.Name]
            local predPos = getPredictedPos(tHRP, history, Config.NoPredict) or tHRP.Position
            local xOff = Config.TeleportOffsetX or 0
            local yOff = Config.YOffset or 0
            local zOff = Config.TeleportOffsetZ or 0
            local targetPos = predPos + Vector3.new(xOff, yOff, zOff)
            local myPos = myHRP.Position
            local distance = (targetPos - myPos).Magnitude
            -- Match Y so we don't fight gravity when the target is above/below
            if math.abs(myPos.Y - targetPos.Y) > 0.5 then
                myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(myPos.X, targetPos.Y, myPos.Z)
            end
            -- Long-distance: tween toward the target (uses the big file's tween engine)
            if distance > 300 then
                if pauseTwn then pauseTwn(0) end
                -- Direct CFrame write for fast approach — the big file's anti-pullback
                -- handles server kickback. We don't use the tween service here because
                -- the little file's Lock 2 also just TPs when close.
                myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
            else
                -- Close range: TP around the target on the orbit ring.
                local lockPos = GetLock2OrbitPos(targetPos)
                myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(lockPos)
            end
        end)
    end,
})

PVPSettings:AddSlider('Lock2OrbitDist', {
    Text = 'Lock 2 Orbit Distance',
    Default = Config.Lock2OrbitDist or 125,
    Min = 10,
    Max = 500,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(val)
        Config.Lock2OrbitDist = val
    end,
})

end

-- ============================================================
--  BOAT TOOLS
-- ============================================================
-- Only a vehicle we are SITTING IN can be moved: while seated we own the seat
-- assembly. A boat we are not in is server-owned, so any CFrame / PivotTo write
-- on it is reverted by the server -- which is why there is no "move someone
-- else's boat" path here.
-- Button funcs are hoisted onto Runtime.BtnFuncs so each button's keybind can
-- fire the exact same code without duplicating it (register-neutral).
Runtime.BtnFuncs = Runtime.BtnFuncs or {}
-- Bind a BUTTON and its keybind on the SAME row: the button keeps its Func,
-- and the keypicker box is hosted inside the button's own label frame at the
-- right edge (AddKeyPicker only needs a .TextLabel to host its box; the
-- library never reads .Container inside it, so lending the button's label is
-- safe). One keypress == one button click. Also registers the bind's display
-- name for the mini keybind list.
Runtime.BindButtonRow = function(gb, btnInfo, idx, name)
    local btn = gb:AddButton(btnInfo)
    local nativeOK = false
    if btn.AddKeyPicker then
        -- patched library (v14+): native same-row keybind host, pcall-guarded
        -- so a stale/broken hosted copy (the v13 build's Button:AddKeyPicker
        -- called a shadowed Funcs table and nil-errored on the FIRST button)
        -- degrades to the probe fallback below instead of killing the whole
        -- UI build.
        nativeOK = pcall(function()
            btn:AddKeyPicker(idx, {
                Default = 'None',
                Mode = 'Toggle',
                Text = name,
                NoUI = false,
                Callback = btnInfo.Func,
            })
        end)
        if nativeOK then
            for _, ch in ipairs(btn.Inner:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA('Frame') then
                    Runtime.KeyboxUI = Runtime.KeyboxUI or {}
                    Runtime.KeyboxUI[idx] = ch
                end
            end
        else
            -- partial native attempt: clear leftover frames so the fallback
            -- does not stack a second box (Button.Inner only ever holds the
            -- button's TextLabel plus whatever the picker created)
            for _, ch in ipairs(btn.Inner:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA('Frame') then ch:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end
    if not nativeOK then
        -- stock library fallback: lend the button's Inner as the keypicker
        -- host via a probe label, then reposition the box to the right edge
        local probe = gb:AddLabel('')
        local probeLabel = probe.TextLabel
        probe.TextLabel = btn.Inner
        probe:AddKeyPicker(idx, {
            Default = 'None',
            Mode = 'Toggle',
            Text = name,
            NoUI = false,
            Callback = btnInfo.Func,
        })
        probe.TextLabel = probeLabel
        for _, ch in ipairs(btn.Inner:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA('Frame') and ch.Size == UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 15) then
                ch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 15)
                ch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
                ch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 2)
                Runtime.KeyboxUI = Runtime.KeyboxUI or {}
                Runtime.KeyboxUI[idx] = ch
            end
        end
        probeLabel:Destroy()
    end
    -- left-align button text + reserve the keybox strip (the patched library
    -- does this too; harmless to re-apply)
    btn.Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    btn.Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -58, 1, 0)
    btn.Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0)
    btn.Label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    Runtime.BindNames = Runtime.BindNames or {}
    Runtime.BindNames[idx] = name
end
-- Shared facing resolver for both warps: returns a FLAT (Y=0) look vector per
-- the 'Warp Facing' dropdown. 'Target Yaw' restores the original behaviour
-- (face the way the victim faces) WITHOUT copying their pitch/roll -- copying
-- the full pivot was what made the seat BodyGyro oscillate. 'Camera' exists
-- because the seat weld can lag/behind the boat by a frame, so a character-yaw
-- read can feed a stale/tilted yaw back in. The look-point is always built at
-- the SAME height as the eye, so the hull can never pick up pitch/roll.
local function warpFlatLook(tHrp, myHrp)
    local mode = Config.BoatWarpFacing or 'Target Yaw'
    local base
    if mode == 'Target Yaw' and tHrp then
        base = tHrp.CFrame.LookVector
    elseif mode == 'Character Yaw' and myHrp then
        base = myHrp.CFrame.LookVector
    elseif mode == 'Toward Target' and myHrp and tHrp then
        base = tHrp.Position - myHrp.Position
    end
    if not base then
        -- 0.5s camera-stabilize: camera can be mid-update after a teleport/tween,
        -- waiting a half-second avoids reading a stale LookVector that causes
        -- the on-screen camera glitch the owner reported.
        task.wait(0.5)
        local camCF = WS.CurrentCamera and WS.CurrentCamera.CFrame
        base = (camCF and camCF.LookVector) or (myHrp and myHrp.CFrame.LookVector) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end
    local flat = Vector3.new(base.X, 0, base.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
    return flat
end
Runtime.BtnFuncs.BoatWarpSel = function()
    local target = getSelectedPlayer()
    local tHrp = target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    -- InfY's "vehiclegoto / vtp" method: read the vehicle straight off the
    -- seat we are sitting in, then pivot the WHOLE model onto the target in
    -- one write. Every part moves together, so there is no weld lag or
    -- tearing (which is what dragging the boat along via our own HRP caused),
    -- and our character comes along because we are welded into the drive seat.
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local seat = hum and hum.SeatPart
    local boat = seat and seat:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
    local myHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (tHrp and boat and myHrp) then return end
    if pauseTwn then pauseTwn(0.5) end
    local eye = tHrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    pcall(function() boat:PivotTo(CFrame.new(eye, eye + warpFlatLook(tHrp, myHrp))) end)
end
Runtime.BindButtonRow(PVPLeft, { Text = 'Boat Warp To Selected', Func = Runtime.BtnFuncs.BoatWarpSel }, 'BoatWarpSelKey', 'Boat Warp To Selected')
PVPLeft:AddDropdown('BoatWarpFacing', {
    Text = 'Warp Facing',
    Values = { 'Target Yaw', 'Camera', 'Character Yaw', 'Toward Target' },
    Default = Config.BoatWarpFacing or 'Target Yaw',
    Multi = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if type(v) == 'table' then v = v.Title or v.Value end
        Config.BoatWarpFacing = v
    end,
})
-- Shared warp core: same facing write, any target HRP (used by Warp All).
local function boatWarpToHrp(tHrp)
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local seat = hum and hum.SeatPart
    local boat = seat and seat:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
    local myHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (tHrp and tHrp.Parent and boat and myHrp) then return false end
    if pauseTwn then pauseTwn(0.5) end
    local eye = tHrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    local ok = pcall(function() boat:PivotTo(CFrame.new(eye, eye + warpFlatLook(tHrp, myHrp))) end)
    return ok
end
Runtime.S.BoatWarpAllGen = Runtime.S.BoatWarpAllGen or 0
PVPLeft:AddToggle('BoatWarpAll', {
    Text = 'Boat Warp All Enemies',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(val)
        Config.BoatWarpAll = val
        Runtime.S.BoatWarpAllGen = (Runtime.S.BoatWarpAllGen or 0) + 1
        if not val then return end
        local myGen = Runtime.S.BoatWarpAllGen
        task.spawn(function()
            while Runtime.Alive and Config.BoatWarpAll and Runtime.S.BoatWarpAllGen == myGen do
                local char = player.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not (hum and hum.SeatPart) then
                    task.wait(0.5)
                else
                    local victims = {}
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p ~= player and not IsAlly(p) then
                            local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if hrp then victims[#victims + 1] = hrp end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, hrp in ipairs(victims) do
                        if not (Runtime.Alive and Config.BoatWarpAll and Runtime.S.BoatWarpAllGen == myGen) then break end
                        char = player.Character
                        hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if not (hum and hum.SeatPart) then break end
                        boatWarpToHrp(hrp)
                        task.wait(Config.BoatWarpAllDelay)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
            end
        end)
    end,
})
PVPLeft:AddInput('BoatWarpAllDelay', {
    Text = 'Warp All Delay (s)',
    Default = tostring(Config.BoatWarpAllDelay),
    Numeric = true,
    Finished = false,
    Callback = function(text)
        local v = tonumber(text)
        if v then Config.BoatWarpAllDelay = math.clamp(v, 0.1, 10) end
    end,
})
Runtime.BtnFuncs.BoardNearest = function()
    local myHrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHrp then return end
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, boat in ipairs(findBoats()) do
        for _, d in ipairs(boat:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("VehicleSeat") and not d.Occupant then
                local dist = (d.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then best, bestDist = d, dist end
            end
        end
    end
    if not best then return end
    if pauseTwn then pauseTwn(0.5) end
    -- Two studs above the seat so the game's own seat weld engages on
    -- contact; writing straight into the seat tends to bounce off it.
    pcall(function() myHrp.CFrame = best.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0) end)
end
Runtime.BindButtonRow(PVPLeft, { Text = 'Board Nearest Boat', Func = Runtime.BtnFuncs.BoardNearest }, 'BoardNearestKey', 'Board Nearest Boat')
Runtime.BtnFuncs.BringBoat = function()
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local myHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (hum and myHrp) then return end
    if hum.SeatPart then return end
    -- Boat-to-me is a TWO-STEP on purpose. A boat we are not sitting in is
    -- server-owned, so PivotTo / CFrame writes on it are reverted by the
    -- server. That is exactly why neither iruka's "Take Ship" (seat-offset
    -- maths) nor InfY's "vehiclegoto / vtp" (vehicleModel:PivotTo) can bring
    -- a boat to you either -- both read humanoid.SeatPart and move the boat
    -- you are DRIVING onto somebody else. What we can ALWAYS move is our own
    -- character, so: board the nearest free seat, let the game's own weld
    -- make us the driver, then move our character -- and the boat welded to
    -- it -- back to where we were standing. Same writes, reversed order.
    local startCF = myHrp.CFrame
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, boat in ipairs(findBoats()) do
        for _, d in ipairs(boat:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("VehicleSeat") and not d.Occupant then
                local dist = (d.Position - startCF.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then best, bestDist = d, dist end
            end
        end
    end
    if not best then return end
    if pauseTwn then pauseTwn(0.5) end
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function() myHrp.CFrame = best.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0) end)
        local waited = 0
        while Runtime.Alive and waited < 2 and hum.SeatPart ~= best do
            task.wait(0.1)
            waited = waited + 0.1
        end
        -- Never seated (weld refused, seat taken, boat despawned): leave the
        -- player where they are rather than yanking them around blind.
        if hum.SeatPart ~= best then return end
        task.wait(0.1)
        pcall(function() myHrp.CFrame = startCF end)
    end)
end
Runtime.BindButtonRow(PVPLeft, { Text = 'Bring Boat To Me', Func = Runtime.BtnFuncs.BringBoat }, 'BringBoatKey', 'Bring Boat To Me')

do
-- ===== Boat Equip: re-equips your last weapon when the game =====
-- ===== unequips it because you sat on a VehicleSeat (boat).    =====
-- Blox Fruits' own client script listens to Humanoid.Seated and calls
-- Humanoid:UnequipTools() the instant you sit on a boat driver seat.
-- We track your last tool, watch for the unequip, and re-equip it.
Runtime.BoatEquip = {
    LastTool = nil,
    Conns = {},
}
local function clearBoatEquipConns()
    for _, c in ipairs(Runtime.BoatEquip.Conns) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    Runtime.BoatEquip.Conns = {}
end
local function tryReequipTool(char, hum, tool)
    if not (char and hum and tool) then return false end
    if not tool.Parent then return false end
    if tool.Parent == char then return true end
    if not tool:IsA('Tool') then return false end
    pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end)
    if tool.Parent ~= char then
        pcall(function() tool.Parent = char end)
    end
    return tool.Parent == char
end
local function hookCharacterForBoatEquip(char)
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    if not hum then
        task.delay(0.5, function() hookCharacterForBoatEquip(char) end)
        return
    end
    clearBoatEquipConns()
    local currentTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Tool')
    if currentTool then Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool = currentTool end
    table.insert(Runtime.BoatEquip.Conns, char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:IsA('Tool') then
            Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool = child
        end
    end))
    table.insert(Runtime.BoatEquip.Conns, char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
        if not Config.BoatEquip then return end
        if not child:IsA('Tool') then return end
        local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not h then return end
        if not (h.SeatPart and h.SeatPart:IsA('VehicleSeat')) then return end
        if Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool == nil or not Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool.Parent then
            Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool = child
        end
        task.delay(0.05, function()
            if char and char.Parent and h and h.Parent then
                tryReequipTool(char, h, child)
            end
        end)
    end))
    table.insert(Runtime.BoatEquip.Conns, hum.Seated:Connect(function(seated)
        if not Config.BoatEquip then return end
        if not seated then return end
        if not (hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsA('VehicleSeat')) then return end
        task.delay(0.1, function()
            if not (hum and hum.Parent and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsA('VehicleSeat')) then return end
            local equipped = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Tool')
            if equipped then
                Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool = equipped
                return
            end
            if Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool and Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool.Parent then
                tryReequipTool(char, hum, Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool)
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.4, function()
            if not (hum and hum.Parent and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsA('VehicleSeat')) then return end
            local equipped = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Tool')
            if not equipped and Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool and Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool.Parent then
                tryReequipTool(char, hum, Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool)
            end
        end)
    end))
end
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(0.15) do
        if not Config.BoatEquip then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then continue end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not hum then continue end
        if not (hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsA('VehicleSeat')) then continue end
        local equipped = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Tool')
        if equipped then continue end
        if Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool and Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool.Parent then
            tryReequipTool(char, hum, Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool)
        end
    end
end)
if player.Character then hookCharacterForBoatEquip(player.Character) end
Runtime:TrackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool = nil
    task.wait(0.5)
    hookCharacterForBoatEquip(char)
end))
end
CombatRight:AddToggle('BoatEquip', {
    Text = 'Boat Equip (re-equip weapon on boat)',
    Default = Config.BoatEquip,
    Tooltip = 'Re-equips your last weapon when the game unequips it because you sat on a boat.',
    Callback = function(val)
        Config.BoatEquip = val
        if val then
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if hum and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsA('VehicleSeat') then
                local equipped = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Tool')
                if not equipped and Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool and Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool.Parent then
                    tryReequipTool(char, hum, Runtime.BoatEquip.LastTool)
                end
            end
        end
    end,
})

CombatRight:AddToggle('BoatESP', {
    Text = 'Boat ESP',
    Default = Config.BoatESP,
    Callback = function(val)
        Config.BoatESP = val
    end,
})
-- Boat ESP loop. Every helper and the state table live inside this thread, so
-- nothing is added to the UI block's register budget. Billboards are built with
-- the portal-ESP helper (same Jester look) and tracked through
-- Runtime:TrackInstance, so Runtime:Dispose still tears them down on re-execute.
Runtime.BoatESP = { Objects = {} }
task.spawn(function()
    local function removeBoat(part)
        local data = Runtime.BoatESP.Objects[part]
        if not data then return end
        Runtime:UntrackInstance(data.billboard)
        pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end)
        Runtime.BoatESP.Objects[part] = nil
    end
    local function isDriving(boat)
        local char = player.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return false end
        for _, d in ipairs(boat:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("VehicleSeat") and d.Occupant == hum then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    while Runtime.Alive do
        task.wait(Config.BoatESPUpdateInterval)
        pcall(function()
            if not Config.BoatESP then
                for part in pairs(Runtime.BoatESP.Objects) do removeBoat(part) end
                return
            end
            local mH = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local seen = {}
            for _, boat in ipairs(findBoats()) do
                local part = boat.PrimaryPart or boat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if part then
                    seen[part] = true
                    local data = Runtime.BoatESP.Objects[part]
                    if not data then
                        local bb, lbl = makePortalBillboard(part, Config.ESPTextSize + 14,
                            Config.ESPStudsOffset + 4, { 237, 233, 254 })
                        if not lbl then lbl = bb:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel") end
                        bb.Name = "SamiHubBoatESP"
                        data = { billboard = bb, label = lbl, lastText = nil }
                        Runtime.BoatESP.Objects[part] = data
                    end
                    local dist = mH and math.floor((mH.Position - part.Position).Magnitude) or 0
                    local visible = mH and dist <= Config.BoatESPMaxDistance
                    data.billboard.Enabled = visible and true or false
                    if visible and data.label then
                        local text = string.format(
                            "<font color='rgb(237,233,254)'>%s</font>  <font color='rgb(168,85,247)'>%dm</font>%s",
                            boat.Name, dist,
                            isDriving(boat) and "  <font color='rgb(120,220,120)'>YOU</font>" or "")
                        if text ~= data.lastText then
                            data.label.Text = text
                            data.lastText = text
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for part in pairs(Runtime.BoatESP.Objects) do
                if not seen[part] or not part.Parent then removeBoat(part) end
            end
        end)
    end
end)
local HopLeft = Tabs['Server Hop']:AddLeftGroupbox('Server Scanner')
local HopRight = Tabs['Server Hop']:AddRightGroupbox('Manual Server Select')
HopLeft:AddInput('MinBounty', {
    Text = 'Min Bounty',
    Default = tostring(Config.BountyMinBounty),
    Numeric = true,
    Callback = function(text)
        local val = tonumber(text)
        if val and val >= 0 then
            Config.BountyMinBounty = val
        end
    end,
})

HopRight:AddDropdown('ServerList', {
    Values = {},
    Default = 1,
    Multi = false,
    Text = 'Server List',
    Callback = function(selected)
        if selected == nil then return end
        if type(selected) == "string" and selected ~= "" then
            local idx = selected:match("^#(%d+)")
            if idx then
                local numIdx = tonumber(idx)
                if ScannedServers[numIdx] then
                    SelectedServerJob = ScannedServers[numIdx].Job
                    print("[ServerHop] Selected:", selected, "->", SelectedServerJob)
                elseif ScannedServerLabels[numIdx] then
                    SelectedServerJob = ScannedServerLabels[numIdx].Job
                    print("[ServerHop] Selected:", selected, "->", SelectedServerJob)
                end
            end
        end
    end,
})

    task.wait(1)
    local gui = player:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')

                        if lbl:IsA('TextLabel') then
                            lbl.RichText = true
                            if lbl.Font then
                                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

Runtime.BtnFuncs.JoinManual = function()
    -- Read the live box first (Finished=false still only fires on Enter on
    -- some Linoria builds); chunk var is the fallback.
    local live = ""
    pcall(function() live = tostring(Options.ManualJobId.Value or "") end)
    local id = (live ~= "" and live or (ManualJobIdText or "")):gsub("%s+", "")
    if #id < 6 then
        warn("[ServerHop] Paste a JobId first")
        return
    end
    print("[ServerHop] Joining manual: " .. id)
    BH_TryJoinServer(id)
end

Runtime.BtnFuncs.ScanServers = function()
    ScanStatusLabel:SetText('Scan Status: Scanning...')
    SelectedServerJob = nil
    ScannedServers = {}
    ScannedServerLabels = {}
    ScanGeneration = ScanGeneration + 1
    local myScanGen = ScanGeneration
    task.spawn(function()
        if not Runtime.Alive then return end
        local servers = BH_FetchAllServers(Config.BountyMinBounty)
        if not Runtime.Alive or ScanGeneration ~= myScanGen then return end
        ScannedServers = servers
        local labels = {}
        for i, info in ipairs(servers) do
            labels[i] = ("#%d %s %sp %s"):format(
                i,
                tostring(info.Region or "?"):match("^([^,]+)"),
                tostring(info.Count or "?"),
                BH_shortBounty(info.Bounty))
            ScannedServerLabels[i] = {
                Bounty = BH_shortBounty(info.Bounty),
                Job = info.Job,
            }
        end
                if not Runtime.Alive or ScanGeneration ~= myScanGen then return end
        ScanStatusLabel:SetText('Scan Status: ' .. (#servers > 0 and ("Found " .. #servers .. " servers") or "No servers found"))
        if #labels > 0 then
            Options.ServerList:SetValues(labels)
        end
    end)
end
Runtime.BindButtonRow(HopRight, { Text = 'Scan Servers', Func = Runtime.BtnFuncs.ScanServers }, 'ScanServersKey', 'Scan Servers')

HopLeft:AddDropdown('PreferredRegions', {
    Values = BountyRegionList,
    Default = 1,
    Multi = true,
    Text = 'Preferred Regions',
    Callback = function(selected)
        for _, name in ipairs(BountyRegionList) do
            BountySelectedRegions[name] = false
        end
        if type(selected) == "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(selected) do
                local name
                if v == true and type(k) == "string" then
                    name = k
                elseif type(v) == "string" then
                    name = v
                end
                if name and BountySelectedRegions[name] ~= nil then
                    BountySelectedRegions[name] = true
                end
            end
        elseif type(selected) == "string" then
            if BountySelectedRegions[selected] ~= nil then
                BountySelectedRegions[selected] = true
            end
        end
    end,
})

end

-- Attach exactly one keybind to every toggle after construction. Existing
-- Noclip/WalkFling bindings keep their original Options indexes so saved
-- assignments load unchanged; new toggles use <idx>Key. The helper lives on
-- Runtime so its locals stay out of the UI block's register budget.
Runtime.AttachToggleKeybinds = function()
    Runtime.BindNames = Runtime.BindNames or {}
    Runtime.BindNames.NoclipKey = 'Noclip'
    Runtime.BindNames.WalkFlingKey = 'Fling'
    for toggleId, toggle in pairs(Toggles) do
        if toggle.Type == 'Toggle' and toggle.Addons then
            local hasKey = false
            for _, addon in ipairs(toggle.Addons) do
                if addon.Type == 'KeyPicker' then hasKey = true break end
            end
            if not hasKey then
                local baseIdx = toggleId .. 'Key'
                local keyIdx = baseIdx
                local suffix = 1
                while Options[keyIdx] do
                    suffix = suffix + 1
                    keyIdx = baseIdx .. suffix
                end
                Runtime.BindNames[keyIdx] = toggle.TextLabel and toggle.TextLabel.Text or toggleId
                toggle:AddKeyPicker(keyIdx, {
                    Default = 'None',
                    SyncToggleState = true,
                    Mode = 'Toggle',
                    Text = toggle.TextLabel and toggle.TextLabel.Text or toggleId,
                    NoUI = false,
                })
                Runtime.KeyboxUI = Runtime.KeyboxUI or {}
                Runtime.KeyboxUI[keyIdx] = toggle.TextLabel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Frame')
            end
            for _, addon in ipairs(toggle.Addons) do
                if addon.Type == 'KeyPicker' then
                    addon.Toggled = toggle.Value
                    addon:Update()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

})

    })

    Runtime.KeyboxUI.LockTarget = lockLabel.TextLabel and lockLabel.TextLabel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Frame')
end

-- Config persistence: the patched library fires Library:AttemptSave() on every
-- widget change (toggles, sliders, inputs, dropdowns, keypicker key + mode), but
-- that hook only does anything when Library.SaveManager is set AND the save has
-- a target config -- before this block the hook was dead and only the explicit
-- Create/Overwrite buttons ever wrote a file. Track the active config (created,
-- loaded, or picked in the Config list) and let a name-less save write into it,
-- so every change -- keybinds included -- is remembered in the config being
-- edited. Loads never call AttemptSave themselves, so loading a config cannot
-- overwrite it.
do
    local baseSave, baseLoad = SaveManager.Save, SaveManager.Load
    local function syncConfigList(name)
        if not name then return end
        task.defer(function()
            local dd = Options.SaveManager_ConfigList
            if dd and dd.Value ~= name then
                dd:SetValues(SaveManager:RefreshConfigList())
                dd:SetValue(name)
            end
        end)
    end
    function SaveManager:Save(name)
        local target = name or self.Selected
        local ok, err = baseSave(self, target)
        if ok and target then
            self.Selected = target
            if name then syncConfigList(name) end
        end
        return ok, err
    end
    function SaveManager:Load(name)
        local ok, err = baseLoad(self, name)
        if ok and name then
            self.Selected = name
            syncConfigList(name)
        end
        return ok, err
    end
    if Options.SaveManager_ConfigList then
        Options.SaveManager_ConfigList.Callback = function(val)
            if val then SaveManager.Selected = val end
        end
    end
    Library.SaveManager = SaveManager
end
if Runtime.AttachToggleKeybinds then Runtime.AttachToggleKeybinds() Runtime.AttachToggleKeybinds = nil end
-- Widen every stock 28x15 keybox to 44x15 so an unbound 'None' is not clipped
-- to 'Non' (it overlapped rows at narrow window sizes). Keyboxes are the only
-- 28x15 frames living in a right-aligned horizontal list.
do
    for _, inst in ipairs(Library.ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA('Frame') and inst.Size == UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 15) then
            local list = inst.Parent and inst.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIListLayout')
            if list and list.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
                and list.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
                inst.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 15)
            end
        end
    end
end
-- Fit toggle rows to their groupbox: stock toggle text labels are a FIXED
-- 216px wide, so on narrow columns the right-aligned keybind box lands past
-- the container edge and gets clipped ('keybinds don't fit'). Resize each
-- toggle label to its container's real width and refit whenever a container
-- resizes (autofit / window resize / first render).
do
    local Containers = {}
    local function fitToggleRows()
        for _, toggle in pairs(Toggles) do
            if toggle.Type == 'Toggle' and toggle.TextLabel and toggle.TextLabel.Parent
                and toggle.TextLabel.Parent.Parent then
                local outer = toggle.TextLabel.Parent.Parent
                local container = outer.Parent
                if container and container:IsA('GuiObject') then
                    Containers[container] = true
                    -- reserve 50px on the right for the keybind box so toggle
                    -- text truncates BEFORE reaching it instead of overlapping
                    local w = container.AbsoluteSize.X - outer.Size.X.Offset - 14 - 50
                    if w > 60 then
                        toggle.TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0)
                        toggle.TextLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    fitToggleRows()
    task.defer(fitToggleRows)
    for container in pairs(Containers) do
        pcall(function()
            Runtime:TrackConnection(container:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'):Connect(fitToggleRows))
        end)
    end
end
-- Keybind pick-cancel: the stock picker binds EVERY input while it waits
-- (Escape and M1 included), so there was no way to back out. Snapshot each
-- picker the moment its box shows the '' / '...' picking animation; if the
-- picked input turns out to be Escape or M1, restore the previous bind, and
-- Delete clears to 'None' (stock Linoria has no unbind at all). Poll-based so
-- no library modification is needed; each revert re-saves the config to fix
-- the transient bad value the stock handler already wrote.
do
    local picking = {}
    local lastText = {}
    task.spawn(function()
        while Runtime.Alive do
            for idx, box in pairs(Runtime.KeyboxUI or {}) do
                local inner = box and box:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Frame')
                local disp = inner and inner:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('TextLabel')
                local picker = Options[idx]
                if disp and picker then
                    local t = disp.Text
                    -- the picking animation cycles '' -> '.' -> '..' -> '...',
                    -- so ALL four mean 'still picking'; only a real key text
                    -- ends the pick. (Checking only ''/'...' made the poll
                    -- drop the snapshot during '.'/'..' frames -- which is why
                    -- ESC/M1 rarely reverted while Delete usually did.)
                    local anim = (t == '' or t == '.' or t == '..' or t == '...')
                    if anim then
                        if picking[picker] == nil then picking[picker] = picker.Value end
                    elseif picking[picker] then
                        local prev = picking[picker]
                        picking[picker] = nil
                        if picker.Value == 'Escape' or picker.Value == 'MB1' then
                            picker.Value = prev
                            disp.Text = prev
                            pcall(function() Library:AttemptSave() end)
                        elseif picker.Value == 'Delete' then
                            picker.Value = 'None'
                            disp.Text = 'None'
                            pcall(function() Library:AttemptSave() end)
                        end
                    end
                    -- live keybox width: fit the CURRENT key text (the stock
                    -- 28px box clips 'None' and anything longer, e.g. the
                    -- RightControl menu bind)
                    if lastText[box] ~= t then
                        lastText[box] = t
                        local w = 44
                        if t ~= '' and t ~= '...' then
                            pcall(function()
                                w = math.max(44, select(1, Library:GetTextBounds(t, Library.Font, 13)) + 10)
                            end)
                        end
                        box.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 15)
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
end
-- Mini keybind list: draggable on-screen panel listing every BOUND keybind as
-- '[Key] Name', accent-coloured while its state is active. Unbound pickers
-- (Value 'None') never appear, so it stays short. Toggle via Settings >
-- Keybinds > Show Keybind List. Poll-based so later binds show up too.
do
    local ButtonBindNames = {
        LockTarget = 'Lock Target',
    }
    for k, v in pairs(ButtonBindNames) do Runtime.BindNames[k] = v end
    local BindFrame = Library:Create('Frame', {
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0);
        BorderColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0);
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0);
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 120);
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 21);
        Visible = false;
        ZIndex = 90;
        Parent = Library.ScreenGui;
    });
    pcall(function() Runtime:TrackInstance(BindFrame) end)
    local BindInner = Library:Create('Frame', {
        BackgroundColor3 = Library.MainColor;
        BorderColor3 = Library.OutlineColor;
        BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset;
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
        ZIndex = 91;
        Parent = BindFrame;
    });
    Library:AddToRegistry(BindInner, {
        BackgroundColor3 = 'MainColor';
        BorderColor3 = 'OutlineColor';
    }, true);
    local BindAccent = Library:Create('Frame', {
        BackgroundColor3 = Library.AccentColor;
        BorderSizePixel = 0;
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2);
        ZIndex = 92;
        Parent = BindInner;
    });
    Library:AddToRegistry(BindAccent, { BackgroundColor3 = 'AccentColor'; }, true);
    local BindTitle = Library:CreateLabel({
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 16);
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 3);
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;
        TextSize = 15;
        Text = 'Keybinds';
        ZIndex = 93;
        Parent = BindInner;
    });
    local BindRows = Library:Create('Frame', {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1;
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 19);
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -19);
        ZIndex = 92;
        Parent = BindInner;
    });
    Library:Create('UIListLayout', {
        FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical;
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;
        Parent = BindRows;
    });
    Library:Create('UIPadding', {
        PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5);
        PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5);
        Parent = BindRows;
    });
    Library:MakeDraggable(BindFrame);
    local Rows = {}
    task.spawn(function()
        while Runtime.Alive do
            local seen, count = {}, 0
            for idx, opt in pairs(Options) do
                if opt.Type == 'KeyPicker' and idx ~= 'MenuKeybind' and opt.Value ~= 'None' then
                    seen[idx] = true
                    count = count + 1
                    local row = Rows[idx]
                    if not row then
                        row = Library:CreateLabel({
                            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16);
                            TextSize = 15;
                            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd;
                            ZIndex = 93;
                            Parent = BindRows;
                        });
                        Rows[idx] = row
                    end
                    row.Visible = true
                    row.Text = string.format('[%s] %s', opt.Value, (Runtime.BindNames or {})[idx] or idx)
                    local state = false
                    pcall(function() state = opt:GetState() end)
                    row.TextColor3 = state and Library.AccentColor or Library.FontColor
                end
            end
            for idx, row in pairs(Rows) do
                if not seen[idx] then row.Visible = false end
            end
            BindFrame.Visible = Config.ShowBindList and count > 0
            BindFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 21 + 16 * count)
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
    end)
end
SaveManager:LoadAutoloadConfig()
pcall(function()
    local colH = math.floor(500 * UIScaleFactor) - 80
    for _, frame in ipairs(Library.ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if frame:IsA('ScrollingFrame') and frame.ScrollBarThickness == 0
            and frame.Size.Y.Offset == 509 then
            frame.Size = UDim2.new(frame.Size.X.Scale, frame.Size.X.Offset, 0, colH)
        end
    end
end)
end
do
if IsMobile or Config.FlyPanelOnPC then
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SamiHubFlyPanel'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
    gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    Runtime:TrackInstance(gui)
    Runtime.FlyPanel = gui
    local frame = Instance.new('Frame')
    frame.Name = 'SamiHub'
    frame.Active = true
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(27, 25, 38)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.38, 0)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 132)
    frame.Parent = gui
    local frameCorner = Instance.new('UICorner')
    frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    frameCorner.Parent = frame
    local function makeButton(name, text, x, y, w, h, color)
        local button = Instance.new('TextButton')
        button.Name = name
        button.BackgroundColor3 = color
        button.BorderSizePixel = 0
        button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
        button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        button.Text = text
        button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(237, 233, 254)
        button.TextSize = 12
        button.AutoButtonColor = true
        button.Parent = frame
        local corner = Instance.new('UICorner')
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        corner.Parent = button
        return button
    end
    local dragBar = Instance.new('TextLabel')
    dragBar.Name = 'DragBar'
    dragBar.Active = true
    dragBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 17, 26)
    dragBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dragBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
    dragBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    dragBar.Text = 'Sami Hub  ≡'
    dragBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
    dragBar.TextSize = 12
    dragBar.Parent = frame
    local dragCorner = Instance.new('UICorner')
    dragCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    dragCorner.Parent = dragBar
    local menuButton = makeButton('Menu', 'MENU', 4, 29, 202, 25, Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247))
    local flyButton = makeButton('FlyToggle', 'FLY: OFF', 4, 58, 70, 30, Color3.fromRGB(57, 53, 68))
    local upButton = makeButton('Up', 'UP', 78, 58, 62, 30, Color3.fromRGB(57, 53, 68))
    local downButton = makeButton('Down', 'DOWN', 144, 58, 62, 30, Color3.fromRGB(57, 53, 68))
    local minusButton = makeButton('Minus', '-', 4, 94, 38, 30, Color3.fromRGB(57, 53, 68))
    local speedLabel = makeButton('Speed', '1', 46, 94, 118, 30, Color3.fromRGB(57, 53, 68))
    local plusButton = makeButton('Plus', '+', 168, 94, 38, 30, Color3.fromRGB(57, 53, 68))
    local closeButton = makeButton('Close', 'X', 180, 0, 30, 24, Color3.fromRGB(192, 38, 74))
    closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    local function updateFlyButton()
        flyButton.Text = Config.Fly and 'FLY: ON' or 'FLY: OFF'
        flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Config.Fly and Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247) or Color3.fromRGB(57, 53, 68)
        speedLabel.Text = ('SPEED: %d'):format(Runtime.MobileFly.SpeedLevel)
    end
    Runtime.FlyPanelUpdate = updateFlyButton
    updateFlyButton()
    local function bindConnection(signal, callback)
        Runtime:TrackConnection(signal:Connect(callback))
    end
    bindConnection(menuButton.Activated, function()
        if Runtime.Alive then task.spawn(Library.Toggle) end
    end)
    bindConnection(flyButton.Activated, function()
        Config.Fly = not Config.Fly
        if Config.Fly then startFly() else stopFly() end
        updateFlyButton()
    end)
    bindConnection(plusButton.Activated, function()
        Runtime.MobileFly.SpeedLevel = math.clamp(Runtime.MobileFly.SpeedLevel + 1, 1, 20)
        updateFlyButton()
    end)
    bindConnection(minusButton.Activated, function()
        Runtime.MobileFly.SpeedLevel = math.max(Runtime.MobileFly.SpeedLevel - 1, 1)
        updateFlyButton()
    end)
    local function bindHold(button, setState)
        bindConnection(button.InputBegan, function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                setState(true)
            end
        end)
        bindConnection(button.InputEnded, function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                setState(false)
            end
        end)
    end
    bindHold(upButton, function(value) Runtime.MobileFly.Up = value end)
    bindHold(downButton, function(value) Runtime.MobileFly.Down = value end)
    bindConnection(closeButton.Activated, function()
        Runtime.MobileFly.Up = false
        Runtime.MobileFly.Down = false
        gui.Enabled = false
        Runtime.FlyPanelClosed = true
    end)
    do
        local dragging = false
        local activeInput = nil
        local dragStart = nil
        local startPosition = nil
        bindConnection(dragBar.InputBegan, function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging = true
                activeInput = input
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPosition = frame.Position
            end
        end)
        bindConnection(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
            if dragging and input == activeInput then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end)
        bindConnection(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
            if input == activeInput then
                dragging = false
                activeInput = nil
            end
        end)
    end
end
end
if Toggles.PermanentMobBring and Toggles.PermanentMobBring.Value then
    Runtime.MobBring:Start()
else
    Runtime.MobBring:Stop()
end
Runtime.Cleanup = function(reason)
    Runtime.S.TwRunning = false
    BountyHopActive = false
    BountyHopGen = BountyHopGen + 1
    ScanGeneration = ScanGeneration + 1
    Runtime.S.PanicFleeRunning = false
    -- Silent Aim cleanup (little-file style)
    if Runtime.SilentAim then
        if Runtime.SilentAim.Circle then
            pcall(function() Runtime.SilentAim.Circle:Remove() end)
            Runtime.SilentAim.Circle = nil
        end
        if Runtime.SilentAim.Line then
            pcall(function() Runtime.SilentAim.Line:Remove() end)
            Runtime.SilentAim.Line = nil
        end
    end
    pcall(stopFly)
    Runtime.FlyPanelUpdate = nil
    pcall(stopNoclip)
    pcall(Features.Haki.Stop)
    pcall(Features.Ken.Stop)
    pcall(Features.PvP.Stop)
    pcall(Features.V4.Stop)
    pcall(Features.V3.Stop)
    pcall(Features.Flag.Stop)
    pcall(Features.Fruit.Stop)
    pcall(Features.SpecialFruit.Stop)
    pcall(stopTwn)
    pcall(stopPanicFlee)
    pcall(function() Runtime.MobBring:Stop() end)
    pcall(function() miscSetWater(false) end)
    pcall(function() miscSetGhostShip(false) end)
    if Config.RemoveAnimations then pcall(miscRestoreAnimations) else pcall(miscClearConns) end
    pcall(clearESP)
    pcall(clearPortalESP)
    Runtime.S.SpectateEnabled = false
    pcall(StopSpectating)
    if SetupCharConn then
        Runtime:UntrackConnection(SetupCharConn)
        SetupCharConn:Disconnect()
        SetupCharConn = nil
    end
    clearCharSetupConns()
    if FlyRespawnConn then
        Runtime:UntrackConnection(FlyRespawnConn)
        FlyRespawnConn:Disconnect()
        FlyRespawnConn = nil
    end
    if InputBeganConn then
        Runtime:UntrackConnection(InputBeganConn)
        InputBeganConn:Disconnect()
        InputBeganConn = nil
    end
    print('Sami Hub disposed: ' .. tostring(reason or 'unknown'))
end
Library:OnUnload(function()
    Runtime:Dispose('library_unload')
end)
local PlayerDropdownState = { LastValuesHash = nil, Queued = false, PlayerConnections = {} }
local function refreshPlayerDropdown()
    local names = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and not CachedAllies[p] and p.Character then
            local hasChar = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hasChar then
                table.insert(names, p.Name)
            end
        end
    end
    if #names == 0 then
        names = {"No players found"}
    end
    local valuesHash = table.concat(names, "\0")
    if valuesHash == PlayerDropdownState.LastValuesHash then return end
    PlayerDropdownState.LastValuesHash = valuesHash
    Runtime.DropdownRefreshing = true
    pcall(function() Options.SelectPlayer:SetValues(names) end)
    Runtime.DropdownRefreshing = false
end
local function queuePlayerDropdownRefresh()
    if PlayerDropdownState.Queued then return end
    PlayerDropdownState.Queued = true
    task.defer(function()
        PlayerDropdownState.Queued = false
        if Runtime.Alive then refreshPlayerDropdown() end
    end)
end
local function bindPlayerDropdownRefresh(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == player or PlayerDropdownState.PlayerConnections[targetPlayer] then return end
    local conns = {}
    PlayerDropdownState.PlayerConnections[targetPlayer] = conns
    local function refreshAfterCharacterChange()
        queuePlayerDropdownRefresh()
        task.delay(1, function()
            if Runtime.Alive then queuePlayerDropdownRefresh() end
        end)
    end
    conns[#conns + 1] = Runtime:TrackConnection(targetPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(refreshAfterCharacterChange))
    conns[#conns + 1] = Runtime:TrackConnection(targetPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(queuePlayerDropdownRefresh))
end
Runtime:TrackConnection(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(targetPlayer)
    bindPlayerDropdownRefresh(targetPlayer)
    queuePlayerDropdownRefresh()
end))
table.insert(Runtime.PlayerLeave, function(targetPlayer)
    local conns = PlayerDropdownState.PlayerConnections[targetPlayer]
    if conns then
        for _, connection in ipairs(conns) do
            Runtime:UntrackConnection(connection)
            pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
        end
        PlayerDropdownState.PlayerConnections[targetPlayer] = nil
    end
    queuePlayerDropdownRefresh()
end)
for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bindPlayerDropdownRefresh(targetPlayer) end
queuePlayerDropdownRefresh()
task.spawn(function()
    while Runtime.Alive and task.wait(5) do
        if _allyRefreshNeeded then
            _allyRefreshNeeded = false
            queuePlayerDropdownRefresh()
        else
            refreshPlayerDropdown()
        end
    end
end)
RemoveAllLava()
if IsMobile then
    if Runtime.FlyPanel and Config.Fly then startFly() end
else
    if Config.Fly then startFly() end
end
Runtime.S.NoclipUserWant = Config.Noclip == true
Runtime:SyncNoclip()
if Config.WalkFling then Runtime.WalkFling:Start() end
if Config.AutoHaki then Features.Haki.Start() end
if Config.AutoKen then Features.Ken.Start() end
if Config.AutoPvP then Features.PvP.Start() end
if Config.AutoV4 then Features.V4.Start() end
if Config.AutoV3 then Features.V3.Start() end
if Config.PanicFlee then startPanicFlee() end
if Config.FlaggedM1 then Features.Flag.Start() end
if Config.FruitM1 then Features.Fruit.Start() end
if Config.SpecialFruitAura then Features.SpecialFruit.Start() end
if Config.ESP then syncESP() end


-- ============================================================
-- LUMIRA-INSPIRED UI SKIN (UI ONLY; feature logic unchanged)
-- ============================================================
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(1)
    if not Library or not Library.ScreenGui or not Library.ScreenGui.Parent then
        return
    end

    local function applySamiRedGradient(obj)
        if obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then return end
        local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        })
        gradient.Rotation = 45
        gradient.Parent = obj
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(Library.ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
            pcall(applySamiRedGradient, obj)
        end
    end
end)
